title: Working Student (f/m/d) - AI & Product Automation
description:
**Job Description**

**What you´ll build**

* Build simple automations and small internal tools for product workflows, with support from the team
* Prototype AI ideas, such as summarizing or sorting customer feedback with an LLM
* Connect data sources and create basic dashboards
* Test how well AI outputs work and document your findings
* Work with engineers and product managers to turn prototypes into real tools
* Write short documentation and share what you learn
* Pull together basic numbers and reports
* Keep internal documentation up to date
* Help coordinate cross-functional teams and track actions to ensure timely delivery of outcomes

**What you bring**

* At least 1 year' experience with data and products in a SaaS company
* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative subject (computer science, physics, mathematics, engineering, …) or marketing/business management
* Excellent English communication skills
* Prior experience in stakeholder coordination
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
* Very good knowledge of MS Office
* Ability to contribute both independently and as part of a team
* Enrolled in computer science, data science, engineering, information systems or a related field
* Programming basics, ideally Python or JavaScript (university and personal projects count)
* Some hands-on AI experience, e.g. calling an LLM API, writing prompts or a small AI project, plus eagerness to learn more
* Good English
* 10–20 hours per week available
* Coming to the office required
* Ability to deliver with tight deadlines
* Excellent follow-up skills
* You use AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) for studies or projects and enjoy trying new ways to use them
* Organized, curious and a clear communicator
* Excellent listening, communication, interpersonal and presentation skills
* Excellent presentation skills (must have)
* Ability to identify and leverage any opportunity of improvement using AI & Automation

A plus:

* Experience working in a product team
* You can also perform quantitative analysis on complex data sets
* Basic SQL and experience with REST APIs
* Git, cloud platforms or low-code automation tools
* Experience with vector databases or evaluation tools
* Basic knowledge of BI tools or A/B testing

**Where you belong**

Product Excellence:

Product Excellence is a team under the SAP Signavio functional unit where we enable product teams to build exceptional products that delight users and achieve business goals by championing a customer-centric and data-driven approach to product management.  
We provide essential frameworks, tools and best practices necessary to craft strong product strategies, make informed decisions, and execute effectively. By fostering a culture of continuous improvement, we ensure sustained innovation and excellence across the organization

The Product Excellence team comprises multiple specialized sub-units that collectively enable high-performing, scalable, and customer-centric product teams. These include Business Analytics, which provides data-driven insights to support informed decision-making; Practices and Programs Management, which establishes governance, drives execution discipline, and ensures alignment across initiatives; and Curation of Best Practices, focused on defining, standardizing, and continuously improving processes to enable smooth project execution across cross-functional teams.

In addition, the team focuses on Voice of Customer initiatives to systematically capture, analyze, and embed customer feedback into product strategy and delivery. We also manage onboarding and upskilling programs to accelerate new team members’ productivity and continuously enhance the capabilities of existing talent. Finally, the team emphasizes the optimal utilization of available tools, frameworks, and resources to improve operational efficiency, reduce friction, and enable product teams to focus on delivering maximum value.

 **Additional Information**

*Please use the free text field to write your cover letter and explain your motivation. After submitting your application, you will have the option to provide additional documents, such as university transcript of records, copies of any academic degrees earned, and references from former employers including internships.*

*This is a SAP global, strategic, paid working student position that provides students with opportunities to find purpose in their careers.*

*#Workingstudent #Werkstudent #Germany #Deutschland #Student #LIHybrid #SAPGermanStudentsCareers #SAPNextGen #LifeAtSAP*

About SAP  
With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives.  
As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience.

We win with inclusion  
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.  
SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.  
For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.  
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.

AI Usage in the Recruitment Process  
For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process.  
Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.
why_fits: Strong AI Operations & Automation fit. Matches keywords: ai, automation, llm, prompt, vector, vector database.

selected_bullets: Designed and built an internal AI Conversation QA & Evaluation web tool featuring automated workflows and bulk-review evaluation pipelines, enabling agents to audit and benchmark AI quality significantly faster.

Developed an automated Price-Lead Offer Email tool integrating internal admin systems, REST APIs, and low-code automation workflows to extract customer data and auto-generate personalized offer emails.
Implemented, structured, and maintained an AI chatbot, custom databases, and AI knowledge / vector databases, overseeing deployment and retrieval improvements handling 30,000+ monthly conversations.

Performed quantitative analysis on complex, unstructured multi-market datasets using SQL (Redash) and Advanced Excel, building automated company-wide KPI reporting and dashboards in collaboration with 3 project managers.

Built a centralized Google Reviews & Trustpilot management web portal (versioned via Git/GitHub) with template-based smart reply suggestions, turning manual review discovery into a one-click approval workflow.

Led AI integrations and continuous optimization of an AI voice bot across 9 international markets within a cross-functional product team, routing millions of calls, boosting inbound answer rates from 65% to 85% (+20%), and raising call-to-booking conversion to 57.8% (+25%).
cover_letter_paragraphs: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Working Student (f/m/d) - AI & Product Automation role at SAP IT Business Systeme. Through my experience helping scale conversational AI tools, optimizing operational workflows, and building data-driven internal products at Auto1 Group, I have learned that the greatest value comes from combining analytical rigor with practical builder execution. With a Bachelor's degree in Digital Product Management and my ongoing Master's studies in International Business Management in Berlin, I am eager to contribute this hands-on, problem-solving mindset to your team.

In my current role as a Junior Project Manager at Auto1 Group in Berlin, I work closely with product managers, developers, and regional operations leads across nine European markets. A core focus of my work has been conversational AI, where I supported the rollout and continuous tuning of our AI voice bot across 9 markets, routing millions of calls and increasing answer rates from 65% to 85%. I also manage the knowledge architecture and retrieval datasets for an AI chatbot handling over 30,000 monthly inquiries, and built an internal bulk-review QA platform to streamline how agents evaluate model quality.

Beyond day-to-day operations, I genuinely enjoy untangling disorganized datasets and creating solutions that make teams more efficient. In my analytics and reporting work, I frequently write SQL queries in Redash and build dashboards across Excel, Tableau, and Looker Studio so stakeholders have dependable, real-time metrics. When off-the-shelf software falls short, I roll up my sleeves to build lightweight internal tools, whether that means connecting internal systems through REST APIs, automating multi-step workflows, or testing and structuring custom evaluation data. Collaborating in an international Berlin environment has also allowed me to work comfortably across languages, using my native Spanish, fluent English, and working German (B1).

What particularly excites me about SAP IT Business Systeme is the opportunity to bring this mix of analytical curiosity and builder execution to your team. Thank you very much for taking the time to review my application. I would welcome the chance to speak with you and discuss how my background can support SAP IT Business Systeme in this role.

title: Werkstudent Audit Capture & AI Solutions (m/w/d) in Berlin
description:
Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten.
  
  
Du willst im Bereich
**Audit & Assurance – Audit Capture**
strategisch wichtige Projekte von der Identifikation bis hin zur Präsentation begleiten? Unser Team sorgt für maximale Gewinnchancen und schafft die Rahmenbedingungen für eine nachhaltige Marktpräsenz. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als
**Werkstudent Audit Capture & AI Solutions (m/w/d).**
Standorte:
**Frankfurt (Main)**
**, Berlin**
**, Düsseldorf**
**und München**
.
  
  
**Dein Impact:**
Als Werkstudent Audit Capture & AI Solutions (m/w/d) unterstützt du unser Team bei der Weiterentwicklung datengetriebener und AI-gestützter Lösungen für die strategische Geschäftsentwicklung.
  
  

* AI & Prompt Engineering: Du entwickelst und optimierst Prompts für Microsoft Copilot und weitere AI-Anwendungen. Dabei unterstützt du die Automatisierung von Analysen, Recherchen, Präsentationen und Entscheidungsgrundlagen.
* Datenanalyse & Insights: Du analysierst Unternehmens-, Markt- und Wettbewerbsdaten, identifizierst relevante Trends und leitest daraus Handlungsempfehlungen für das Management ab.
* Automatisierung: Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung automatisierter Workflows mit Microsoft Power Automate, Power Platform und weiteren digitalen Tools, um Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten.
* Data Management: Du wirkst bei der Strukturierung, Qualitätssicherung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Datenbestände und Intelligence-Datenbanken mit und schaffst die Basis für fundierte Entscheidungen.
* Reporting & Management Support: Du erstellst KPI-basierte Reports, Dashboards und Management-Präsentationen und unterstützt bei strategischen Projekten des Geschäftsbereichs Audit & Assurance.

**Dein Skillset:**

* Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Betriebswirtschaft, Volkswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs
* Sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse (v. a. Word, Excel, PowerPoint), idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit Power BI, Power Automate oder Power Platform
* Interesse an Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI und Prompt Engineering, im besten Fall erste Kenntnisse im Einsatz mit Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT oder ähnlichen AI-Anwendungen
* Analytisches Denkvermögen sowie Interesse an Datenmanagement, Datenanalyse und digitalen Technologien
* Teamgeist, Begeisterung für Innovation sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

**Deine Chance:**

* Echte Verantwortung für eigene Aufgabenpakete innerhalb unserer Projekte, die du selbständig bearbeitest
* Persönliche:r Mentor:in in deinem Team, der/die dir mit Rat und Tat zur Seite steht und dich mit umfassendem Know-how unterstützt
* Ein chancenreiches und internationales Umfeld, das dir einmalige Einblicke in die Arbeit des weltweit größten Prüfungs- und Beratungsunternehmens bietet
* Work-Life-Balance in einem innovativen Unternehmensumfeld, das dir Gesundheitstage, Mitarbeiter:innen-Events und vieles mehr bietet
* Bereichsübergreifendes Networking im Deloitte Student Network mit exklusiven Vorträgen und regelmäßigem Austausch beim Praktikant:innen-Stammtisch
* Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur – u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke

**Deine Verfügbarkeit:**
Als Werkstudent:in bist du ab sofort für bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche verfügbar, wobei deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestaltet werden kann. In den Semesterferien sind nach Absprache bis zu 40 Stunden pro Woche möglich. Wir suchen Studierende für eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit für mindestens 1 Jahr.
  
  
**Bist du bereit? Mach mit uns den Unterschied!**
Unser Recruiting-Team freut sich auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (CV sowie Abitur-, Hochschul- und Arbeitszeugnisse) über unser Online-Formular. Ein Anschreiben und ein Bewerbungsfoto sind bei uns nicht erforderlich.
  
  
**Gleiche Chancen für alle**
: Wir begrüßen ausdrücklich auch Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung.
**Noch Fragen?**
Alle Infos zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess findest du in unseren
**Bewerbungs-FAQs**
.
  
  
**Dein Kontakt bei Fragen rund um Karrierethemen**
Unser Team Talent Acquisition – Aleksandra, Anja, Julia, Lea, Lisa, Silja und ihre Teams – unterstützt dich gerne bei allen Fragen rund um deine Karriere bei Deloitte. Du erreichst uns per E-Mail unter career@deloitte.de oder telefonisch unter +49 211 87724111.

title: Working Student, Offshore O&M Asset Management, Partner Management & Digitalization
description:
**Company:** Iberdrola Renovables Deutschland GmbH
  
**Location:** Berlin, Germany
  
**Working pattern:** Office-based
  
**Department:** Asset Management

  
  

**RESPONSIBILITIES AND FUNCTIONS**

  

The Working Student will support the Offshore O&M Asset Management team in:

  
  

* Support the collection, validation, and reporting of production and metering data for offshore wind assets.
* Support SAP-related activities, including purchase order tracking, invoice follow-up, approval workflows, and payment monitoring.
* Assist with budget preparation, forecasting activities, and cost tracking.
* Assist in the preparation of reports, presentations, procedures, and internal documentation.
* Contribute to the review and improvement of operational and commercial processes, including invoicing, metering, and revenue reporting.
* Perform data analysis, reconciliation, and quality checks across multiple information sources.
* Support special projects related to offshore wind operations, energy markets, business reporting, and process automation.
  

**PROFILE AND REQUIREMENTS**

  

* Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Economics, Business Administration, Energy Management, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Proactive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Fluent English.
* Availability to work from the Berlin office in accordance with the agreed working schedule.
  

**DESIRABLE SKILLS**

  

* Knowledge of SAP.
* Experience with Power BI, Power Query, VBA, Python, or automation tools.
* Interest in renewable energy and offshore wind.
* French, Spanish, or German language skills.
  

**WHAT WE OFFER**

  

* Join a global leader in renewable energy and play an active role in driving the energy transition.

title: Working Student – Applied AI (all genders)
description:
**Locations**
: München | Düsseldorf | Berlin
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
Our strategy? To be anything but typical strategy consultants! Our unconventional nature is embedded deep in our DNA. Over 60 years ago, BCG shook up the world of strategy consulting. Now, it has grown to become one of the world leaders in the field. How do we manage to stay ahead of the pack? The answer is simple: by reinventing ourselves every day and providing a home with diverse career opportunities to the best talent and most creative minds all over the world. And by giving you the chance to make an impact in business and society. BCG stands for authenticity, exceptional work, and strong integrity. Once you’ve become part of the Group, we’ll help you find your path, unleash your potential, effect change, and advance the world.
  
  
#jointhegroup
  
  
Our most vital resource is our people. That’s why Human Resources is one of our most important teams: From recruiting to career development for BCGers, from training and mobility support to staffing (assigning our consultants to client casework), the Human Resources Team plays a decisive role in making BCG not just a company, but a Group in which every employee can become their best.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As a
**Working Student**
in the CE Applied AI Team, you will support the hands-on deployment of AI tools into real case team workflows, helping to translate concrete business needs into practical, lightweight AI-enabled solutions that improve day-to-day project work.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include**

* Supporting AI tool deployment You will help configure and adapt AI tools for selected case teams, including setting up custom GPTs, assisting with prompt optimization, and supporting simple API-based integrations.
* Building and testing prototypes You will develop small prototypes and automations to test new use cases, iterate them based on feedback, and refine solutions into usable setups.
* Assisting with agent and workflow design You will contribute to the design and optimization of AI-supported workflows, including basic prompt engineering and structured experimentation with different tools.
* Providing operational support You will support consultants with technical questions, troubleshooting, and onboarding to AI-enabled workflows, ensuring smooth integration into project work.
* Exploring new GenAI capabilities You will test new AI features and tools and help assess their relevance for internal and case-related use cases.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* You are currently enrolled in a full-time bachelor’s or master’s program in computer science, data science, business informatics, or a related field.
* You have some experience with AI tools and workflows, ideally including API integrations and prompt engineering; experience with tools such as Claude, Cursor, or n8n is a plus.
* You have programming knowledge (Python, JavaScript, or similar)
* You have strong analytical skills and a keen interest in AI-driven process automation.
* You are fluent in English and German.

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* You build before you polish. You default to “let me try it” instead of “let me research it.” You move fast, iterate quickly, and prefer a rough prototype today over a perfect plan next week. You have likely hacked together scripts or lightweight tools to automate something simply because it was faster to build than to wait.
* You are hands-on with Python, APIs, and LLMs. You do not need to be a senior engineer, but you can write a working Python script, call an API, and prompt an LLM effectively. Experience with tools such as Claude, Cursor, or n8n is a plus. What matters most is that you learn new tools quickly and apply them pragmatically.
* You bridge technology and business. You do more than code. You translate messy, ambiguous business problems into structured, automatable workflows. You are comfortable speaking with nontechnical stakeholders, clarifying what they actually need rather than just what they ask for, and delivering solutions that create tangible value.
* You are self-directed and dependable. With limited hours available, you make every session count. You absorb context quickly, work independently between check-ins, and communicate proactively when you are blocked or when you have delivered. You require minimal guidance and manage your time responsibly.
* You are genuinely curious about GenAI and its real-world impact. You experiment with AI tools in your own time, whether building agents, automating personal workflows, or testing what is possible. You see AI as a lever for step-change impact, not incremental improvement.

Who You'll Work With
  
  
You will work autonomously while staying in close alignment with the Applied AI Team and other key stakeholders driving AI adoption at BCG. You will work under the direction of the CE Applied AI Lead, who will provide strategic guidance and ensure a smooth onboarding experience. In addition, you will provide operational support for case teams, assisting with AI-driven workflow optimizations, remote troubleshooting, and hands-on AI tool configuration to ensure seamless integration into day-to-day project work.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**WHAT WE OFFER YOU\***

* Free beverages, fresh fruit, snacks, and cereal are available every day.
* Stop by our coffee machines and treat yourself to your favorite hot drinks!
* Our terrace will invite you to relax with a great view of the city.
* Regular after-work events are organized for team building and fun—we’d love to have you join us!
* As a dynamic, internationally active company, the diverse work environment at BCG will inspire you.
* New ways of working? They’re nothing new to us. Our employees use hybrid models that combine on-site and remote work, supported by digital collaboration tools.
* Our in-house gym is well equipped and free for you to use any time.
* Great location: Right in the heart of the city, our office is close by and easy to reach.
* Benefits may vary by location.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Working Student – Compliance Automation & AI (m/f/d)
description:
**ABOUT US**

Pliant is a modular B2B payments platform that combines commercial card issuing, payment accounts, FX, and spend management in one system — adapting to existing setups rather than requiring customers to replace them.

Businesses across industries such as travel, e-commerce, and insurance use Pliant to manage complex payment workflows with cards, backed by credit lines Pliant underwrites itself.

Fintechs and software platforms embed Pliant's payment infrastructure into their own products, from API-based Cards-as-a-Service to fully white-label solutions. Banks use Pliant's Card & Spend OS, the customer-facing interface, on their own infrastructure to run card programs.

Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Berlin, Pliant serves 5,000+ businesses and 40+ partners across Europe and the United States. A principal member of Visa and Mastercard, Pliant issues commercial cards in 13 currencies across 32 countries — under its own European e-money license and with licensed partners in the UK and US.

Learn more at www.getpliant.com

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for an exceptional working student to join our team — someone who wants to build expertise in fintech and banking, sharpen their analytical skills, and work alongside senior specialists on critical operational risk topics.

As a **Working Student – Compliance Automation & AI (m/f/d)**, you’ll sit at the intersection of fintech, data, and operational risk management. You’ll work on high-impact tasks in client onboarding, risk profiling, and transaction surveillance — while leveraging data-driven applications, Python, and AI tools to enhance efficiency and insight.

You’ll collaborate closely with our Compliance, Risk, Product, and Engineering teams, gaining hands-on experience in one of Europe’s fastest-scaling fintechs.

This role is **Berlin-based** with the ability to work at least **2 days per week from our Berlin HQ.**

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Onboarding, Risk & Transaction Surveillance**

* Verify corporate clients (KYB), identifying legal representatives and beneficial owners through global databases and registries.
* Assess customer risk profiles using structured data, defined frameworks, and regulatory guidelines.
* Review AML alerts from monitoring systems, flag anomalies, and escalate potential cases to senior specialists.
* Analyze transaction patterns to detect suspicious behaviors or potential financial crime indicators.
* Prepare and maintain accurate digital credit files in compliance with internal policies.
* Contribute to the refinement of detection rules to reduce false positives and improve monitoring effectiveness.

**Data & Technology Integration**

* Work with data-driven applications to support decision-making in compliance and monitoring.
* Use Python for data analysis, workflow automation, and reporting.
* Develop and maintain local LLM-based applications.
* Apply prompt engineering to accelerate research, document drafting, and case analysis.

**Process Innovation**

* Collaborate with Product and Engineering to improve tools, workflows, and system logic.
* Suggest automation opportunities and AI-driven enhancements.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**

* Enrolled in a university program in computer science, data science, business informatics, engineering, or a related quantitative field, with a strong academic track record.
* Hands-on automation experience (n8n, Make, Zapier, or code-based pipelines), including API integrations.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Practical experience with LLMs and prompt engineering.
* Structured, detail-oriented, and disciplined about testing and documenting what you build.
* Fluent in English; German or other European languages are a plus.

**Nice to have**

* Interest in fintech and curiosity about compliance topics such as AML/KYC and sanctions screening. Regulatory knowledge is not required; you'll learn it on the job.
* Experience with data analysis, visualization, or BI tools such as Metabase.
* Experience with Taktile or other rules engines, or with KYB/registry/Google Maps APIs.
* Familiarity with Git and AI coding tools such as Claude Code.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* The opportunity to work in a growing team with big responsibilities that thrives on a strong exchange of knowledge and excellence
* Attractive remuneration
* Flat hierarchy and transparent communication in a relaxed, professional atmosphere
* Opportunity to develop your talent in a dynamic team with ambitious goals
* Flexibility and possibility to work remotely
* Monthly mobility benefit
* Wellhub Membership
* Pliant Card with monthly credit to explore the product and enjoy food with colleagues

title: GTM Engineering Working Student
description:
Companies have invested billions into ERP systems. And yet, most business decisions are still made the way they were in 1995: on fragmented data, manual exports, and Excel. Finance teams spend five to ten days every month copy-pasting numbers, and four systems show four versions of the same revenue.

  

AI changes that. At ARC, we are building the AI-native Finance OS: one platform that connects all of a company's systems, answers any question in seconds, finds errors before they cost millions, and automates reporting end to end. Leading Mittelstand companies like Burmester, Pfanner, and Ferrotec, and PE firms like AUCTUS and GENUI, already run their finance on ARC. Finance software is being rebuilt from the ground up this decade, and we intend to win the category.

  

We are a small, AI-native team in Berlin, fresh off our seed round led by 42CAP, growing revenue 10x since our pre-seed. We build, experiment, and move fast, take real ownership, and keep a low-ego culture.

  

**Aufgaben**

  

You are the GTM Engineering Intern at ARC. While our BDRs are on the phone with CFOs, you build the machine behind them: the automations, data pipelines, and AI workflows that decide who we call, with what message, and when. We sell an AI-native platform, so our own go-to-market has to run AI-native too. You'll build our internal GTM OS from the ground up.

  

**What you'll do**

  

  
* Build automated prospecting pipelines: sourcing multi-entity Mittelstand groups and PE-backed companies that fit our ICP, at scale
  
* Enrich accounts and contacts with the signals that matter to us: legal entities, ERP landscape, PE ownership, trigger events like ERP migrations or acquisitions
  
* Automate outreach workflows across email, LinkedIn, and phone, and keep them personal enough that a German CFO actually responds
  
* Connect and orchestrate our GTM stack (HubSpot, Aircall, enrichment and outreach tools) into one system with clean data flowing through it
  
* Use AI models aggressively: for research, list building, message drafting, call analysis, and anything else that removes manual work from the pipeline
  
* Build dashboards and KPI tracking so we always know what's working in outbound and what isn't
  
* Prototype, test, and iterate: your experiments directly shape how ARC's GTM engine works as we scale the sales team
  

  

**Qualifikation**

  

**What makes you a great fit**

  

  
* You love building things: with no-code tools, scripts, APIs, or AI agents, whatever gets it done fastest
  
* You're deep in the modern AI tool stack and use LLMs daily as a matter of course
  
* You're analytical and rigorous with data: messy lists and broken syncs bother you until they're fixed
  
* You have strong business sense and can think from the prospect's perspective, not just the pipeline's
  
* You're hands-on and not afraid of unglamorous work: cleaning a CRM included
  
* You communicate well in English; German is a plus since our market is the German Mittelstand
  
* You want to work with smart and friendly people with (self-reported) low ego
  
* You want to work on-site 5 days a week in our new Berlin office
  

  

**You may not be a good fit if**

  

  
* You need detailed instructions and shy away from taking responsibility
  
* You're not willing to deeply understand the product and the buyer behind your automations
  
* You're only interested in high-level "strategic" work
  
* You think GTM engineering means setting up one Zapier flow
  
* You've never built anything on your own initiative
  
* You prefer working remotely
  
* You prefer working with minimal collaboration
  
* You want to work a 9-5 job

title: Working Student Revenue Operations and GTM Strategy
description:
**The role and the team**
As a Working Student Revenue Operations and GTM Strategy (all genders), you help build Lucanet's scalable revenue engine: keeping GTM data clean, building AI-powered workflows with Clay and Claude, and documenting the processes behind our B2B SaaS revenue. You work hands-on with Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, and Chili Piper from day one and see how a modern RevOps function is run.
  
  
You report into the Revenue Operations & GTM Strategy team within Revenue Architecture & Operations and work closely with RevOps, Deal Desk, and GTM leadership across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Excellence. Your work feeds directly into reporting, process design, and strategic projects such as territory design and our Bowtie operating model, and you work remotely from Germany. We look for people who keep growing, take real ownership, and lift the people around them.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Support data collection, cleansing, and enrichment across our revenue technology stack, including Salesforce and HubSpot.
* Build and test AI-powered GTM workflows with Clay, Claude, Gong, and other automation tools.
* Prepare recurring reports, dashboards, and ad hoc analyses for GTM leadership.
* Support Deal Desk tasks and track key RevOps metrics across the Bowtie model.
* Document end-to-end GTM processes such as lead-to-close and territory handoffs in clear playbooks.
* Research RevOps frameworks, SaaS GTM benchmarks, and AI use cases, and turn findings into recommendations.
* Own clearly scoped sub-tasks in strategic projects and prepare materials for workshops, QBRs, and leadership briefings.

**What You Bring**
**You have:**

* Current enrolment in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Business Administration, Information Management, Data Science, or a related field.
* Hands-on comfort with spreadsheets, dashboards, and structured datasets, for example from university projects or an internship.
* A structured, detail-oriented way of working that produces clean, reliable outputs.
* Ownership of your tasks: you ask good questions, flag blockers early, and follow through.
* Fluent English, written and spoken.

**It's a plus if you also have:**

* First hands-on exposure to AI and automation tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Clay.
* First experience with GTM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, or Chili Piper.
* A strong interest in B2B SaaS, GTM strategy, or revenue operations.

**Perks at work**

* Flexible and hybrid working: our Lucaflex model lets you plan your working hours and location according to your needs and professional responsibilities.
* Remote work from another country: work up to 90 days a year outside your home country, supported by our partner Workflex.
* Professional development budget: get dedicated time, resources, and budget to build the skills for your career path.
* Structured development process: quarterly catch-ups with your manager, built on clear expectations for impact, competence, and influence.
* Paid volunteer days: take the time to volunteer, alone or with your team, for causes you care about.
* Health and wellbeing support: access company wellbeing programs, sport subsidies, and mental health support through external partners.
* Paid vacation days: take 30 days a year to rest, travel, and recharge.
* Pension support: build your retirement savings with employer pension contributions.
* Health and sports support benefit: get additional support for your health and sports activities.
* Corporate benefits platform: get exclusive discounts across travel, retail, technology, and more.

**About Lucanet**
Lucanet is the CFO solution platform for modern finance and tax teams, automating processes from consolidation and financial planning to tax compliance, ESG reporting, and cash management. More than 6,000 companies worldwide rely on our easy-to-use, out-of-the-box SaaS platform. We're PE-backed and growing across global markets.
  
  
Behind the platform is a global team of 900+ people who care about doing the work well. We challenge each other to move fast without cutting corners and build solutions that change how finance and tax leaders operate. If you want your work to have real reach, and your growth is important to you, Lucanet is the right place for you.
  
  
Discover more about Lucanet as an employer.
  
  
**Powered by uniqueness**
Everybody is different here and we like it that way. We welcome people of every gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, national origin, religion, age, and disability, exactly as they are. What you bring is what matters. If you need an adjustment to take part in our hiring process, let us know. See yourself in this role? We want to hear from you.
  
  
Please keep your CV focused on your experience and skills, rather than including your photo, age or marital status.
  
  
Learn more about our DE&I journey.
  
  
**Data protection**
Your personal data will be processed in accordance with GDPR requirements. Find out how we keep your data safe: Lucanet data protection policy.

title: Working Student – Offshore O&M Asset Management
description:
**Company:** Iberdrola Renovables Deutschland GmbH
  
**Location:** Berlin, Germany
  
**Working pattern:** Office-based
  
**Department:** Asset Management

  
  

**MISSION**

  

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Working Student to join our Offshore O&M Asset Management team in Berlin. In this role, you will support a range of operational and commercial activities, with a particular focus on data analysis, reporting, cost tracking, and continuous process improvement.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES AND FUNCTIONS**

  

The Working Student will support the Offshore O&M Asset Management team in:

  
  

* Support the collection, validation, and reporting of production and metering data for offshore wind assets.
* Support SAP-related activities, including purchase order tracking, invoice follow-up, approval workflows, and payment monitoring.
* Assist with budget preparation, forecasting activities, and cost tracking.
* Assist in the preparation of reports, presentations, procedures, and internal documentation.
* Contribute to the review and improvement of operational and commercial processes, including invoicing, metering, and revenue reporting.
* Perform data analysis, reconciliation, and quality checks across multiple information sources.
* Support special projects related to offshore wind operations, energy markets, business reporting, and process automation.
  

**PROFILE AND REQUIREMENTS**

  

* Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Economics, Business Administration, Energy Management, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Proactive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Fluent English.
Availability to work from the Berlin office in accordance with the agreed working schedule.  

  

**DESIRABLE SKILLS**

  

* Knowledge of SAP.
* Experience with Power BI, Power Query, VBA, Python, or automation tools.
* Interest in renewable energy and offshore wind.
* French, Spanish, or German language skills.
  

**PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES**

  

* Proactive and self-driven.
* Curious and eager to learn.
* Comfortable working with data and analytical tasks.
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Ability to identify opportunities for improvement and support their implementation.
Team player with good communication skills.  

  

**WHAT WE OFFER**

  

* Join a global leader in renewable energy and play an active role in driving the energy transition.
* Gain valuable hands-on experience in an international and dynamic work environment.
* Attractive compensation for working students in line with market standards.
* Modern office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte with excellent public transport connections.
* Exclusive employee discounts with numerous partner companies across retail, travel, technology, and other industries.
  

  

**Mobility Information**

Please note that any applicant who is not a citizen of the country of the vacancy will be subject to compliance with the applicable immigration requirements to legally work in that country.

  
  

**Job Posting End Date:**

  
November-30-2026

description:

Diese Rolle ist bei
**Edeneve**
angesiedelt, unserer neuen Kosmetikmarke im Ökosystem von Sunday Natural und Yoshi en. Edeneve steht für hochwertige Hautpflege mit starkem Fokus auf natürliche Inhaltsstoffe, Transparenz und moderne Formulierungswissenschaft. * Bestands- & Lagerverwaltung: Unterstützung beim Monitoring und der Steuerung unserer Bestände und Lagerbestände.

* Prozessoptimierung & Reporting: Unterstützung beim Reporting, Überwachung relevanter KPIs und aktive Mitgestaltung bei der Optimierung interner Abläufe.
* Teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit: Enge Schnittstellenarbeit mit verschiedenen Teams im gesamten Unternehmen.

**Was du mitbringst**

* Immatrikulation an einer deutschen Hochschule oder Universität.
* Fähigkeit, mehrere Aufgaben und Briefings parallel zu strukturieren, ohne den Blick fürs Detail zu verlieren.
* Starke und klare Kommunikation über Teamgrenzen hinweg sowie ein gutes Gespür für Prioritäten und Risiken.
* Hands-on-Mentalität: Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und packst eigeninitiativ an.
* Komfortabler Umgang mit komplexen Datensätzen und digitalen Plattformen.
* Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

**Was bietet Yoshi en?**

* Attraktive Rabatte: Ansprechende Mitarbeitervergünstigungen auf alle Produkte von Yoshi en & Edeneve.

* Corporate Benefits: Zugriff auf ein breites Portal mit Mitarbeiterrabatten (bis zu 50 % bei Partnern aus Shopping, Technik und Reisen).
* Teamevents & Kultur: Regelmäßige Tea-Ceremonies, Office-Partys, Sommer- und Sommerfeste sowie Community-Events.
* Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Unser Büro im Grasblau in Berlin – nachhaltig, hell, mit ruhigen Fokus-Zonen und viel Raum für Zusammenarbeit – sowie kostenfreie Bio-Tees und Superfoods aus aller Welt.

As a multi-brand company, we bring together brands such as
**Yoshi en, Edeneve**
and
**Dr. Schweikart**
, all founded by entrepreneur Jörg Schweikart as independent sister brands of Sunday Natural. While each brand has its own identity, products and stage of growth, they are united by a shared commitment to quality, innovation, fairness and naturalness.
  
  
Our teams work from
**Grasblau**
in Berlin, a modern and sustainable office with plenty of natural light, quiet rooms and spaces designed for collaboration and focused work.

title: Werkstudent:in Energy Operations (m/w/d)
description:
Über uns
  
  
Bei
**VREY**
bauen wir das
**EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser**
.
  
  
In Deutschland stehen über
**3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser**
– und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.
  
  
Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.
  
  
Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.
  
  
**VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software**
und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (
  
  

* 42b EnWG).

Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:
  
  

* Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,
* ~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und
* digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.

Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.
  
  
Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir
**3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs**
(u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.
  
  
Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.
  
  
Dein Profil
  
  

* Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Consulting (Tier 1/Tier 2), High-Growth Start-ups (dealerweise Operations oder Prozessoptimierung), oder im Projektmanagement in Form von Praktika gesammelt
* Du studierst aktuell im Bachelor oder Master in einem relevanten Bereich wie z.B. Wirtschaftsingenieurswesen, Betriebswirtschaft oder Energiewirtschaft
* Du denkst unternehmerisch, triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen und setzt klare Prioritäten mit Blick auf Impact, Skalierbarkeit und langfristigen Unternehmenserfolg
* Du bringst ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Start-ups, Energie oder Immobilien mit

title: Working Student Global Inclusion (m/w/d)
description:
**Title** : Working Student Global Inclusion

**Location** : Berlin

**Application Deadline** : 10. November 2026

**About Springer Nature**

Springer Nature opens the doors to discovery for researchers, educators, clinicians and other professionals. Every day, around the globe, our imprints, books, journals, platforms and technology solutions reach millions of people. For over 180 years our brands and imprints have been a trusted source of knowledge to these communities and today, more than ever, we see it as our responsibility to ensure that fundamental knowledge can be found, verified, understood and used by our communities – enabling them to improve outcomes, make progress, and benefit the generations that follow. Visit springernature.com and follow @SpringerNature

**About the Role**

Are you a student looking for hands-on experience in promoting inclusion within a global organization? If so, this role might be perfect for you! As a working student, you will support Springer Nature’s Global Inclusion Team in developing and implementing global initiatives in areas such as learning and development, communication, employee network support, research and data analysis metrics. You will take ownership of subprojects and gain valuable experience in an international, dynamic environment.

Join our enthusiastic and supportive team of four, where you’ll have the opportunity to work independently on meaningful projects. We offer a collaborative workplace, access to different learning offers and a variety of community events, as well as a book discount of 15–40%.

  

**Role Responsibilities**

* Support participant management for events and training programs, applying **adult learning principles** to help develop engaging and effective training materials.
* Support reporting of engagement & inclusion surveys through data analysis and tracking recurring metrics.
* Prepare research, content, and communication materials for Inclusion initiatives, leveraging **storytelling** and **effective communication** skills to create compelling emails, blog posts, and other communications.
* Schedule and organize events and campaigns, utilizing strong **collaboration** and **project management skills** to ensure successful planning and execution.
* Support community management activities, including employee networks, by demonstrating **interpersonal awareness** and **valuing differences** to create inclusive and engaging communities.
* Provide general project management support, applying a **global perspective** while partnering with diverse stakeholders and contributing to the successful delivery of Inclusion initiatives.

**Experience, Skills and Qualifications**

* Enrolled in a degree in economics, politics, communication, sociology, social science or related disciplines, or in gender and diversity studies

* A good understanding of the field of diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging

* Some experience with project management

* A hands-on, committed and solution-oriented work approach

* Strong written and verbal communication skills

* Fluency in English or German: English is the main language in this area but ideally, we are looking for a candidate who can also provide support in German

Sound working knowledge of MS 365 programmes  



The position is offered on a part-time, fixed-term contract basis, and will be based on a hybrid model in our Berlin offices.

  

Please note we will be reviewing candidate applications as they are submitted and so encourage you to apply as early as possible.

  

At Springer Nature, our mission is to be part of progress – and that begins with inclusion: of people, perspectives, and ideas. We believe that diverse perspectives drive progress, and we are committed to creating an environment where people and ideas can flourish. If you have any access needs related to disability, neurodivergence or a chronic condition, please contact us so we can make all necessary accommodation. Find out more about our DEI work here: https://group.springernature.com/gp/group/taking-responsibility/diversity-equity-inclusion .

For more information about career opportunities in Springer Nature please visit https://springernature.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/SpringerNatureCareers/ .

description:

Digital Transformation Internship

Berlin

Student internship

Internship

T-Systems International GmbH

  

**Internship at Telekom**

  

Do you want to put the theory you have learned into practice and experience and help shape the digital world of tomorrow today? Then you've come to the right place! We can make and copy coffee ourselves; we are looking for interns like you who want to advance the connected world every day with team spirit, a willingness to innovate and perform!

  
  

**T-Systems International GmbH**

  

At T-Systems, we offer our business customers the right system solutions for their digital business. With our portfolio, we ensure that digital transformation reduces complexity, saves costs and makes everyday work easier. Our focus is connectivity, digital, cloud & infrastructure as well as security - Let's power higher performance!

  
  

**About the position**

  

As an intern (m/f/d/x) in the area of digital transformation, you will actively shape the digital transformation in our company. You will be involved in strategic and operational transformation projects right from the start and support our team in analyzing existing processes and implementing sustainable digital solutions.

  
  

**Your tasks**

  

**Whether it's a mandatory or voluntary internship — As an intern (m/f/d/x), you will definitely benefit from attractive remuneration and will support the team with the following responsible tasks from 01.01.2027:**

  

* Active support for strategic digitization and change management initiatives
* Preparation of analyses, dashboards and management presentations using MS Excel and PowerPoint
* Accompaniment of process optimizations and independent promotion of sub-projects
* Interfacing and communication with various internal stakeholders
* Introducing fresh ideas and innovative impulses for the continuous development of our working methods
  

  

**Your profile**

  

You are studying communication sciences, marketing, business administration, a comparable degree program or are in a gap year.

  
  

You also have the following knowledge and skills:

  
  

* **Safe use of MS Office:** In particular, profound knowledge of Excel for data preparation and PowerPoint for creating meaningful presentations
* **Distinctive analytical skills:** Enjoying the structured understanding of complex relationships and deriving recommendations for action
* **Basic understanding of change management:** Great interest in transformation processes and accompanying organizational changes
* **Proactive and independent way of working:** High level of initiative, curiosity and hands-on mentality when faced with new challenges
* **Very good language skills:** Fluent written and spoken German and English
  

  

**Ideally, you should bring that with you**

  

* First practical experience (e.g. through internships or working student activities) in the area of digitization, process optimization or project management
* Basic understanding of agile working methods and methods (e.g. Scrum, Kanban)
* First points of contact with collaboration and project management tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence, Miro, MS Teams)
* Affinity for new technologies and digital trends
  

  

**What we offer**

  

* **Practical insights:** Real responsibility and exciting insights into strategic transformation and digitization projects
* **Mentoring & feedback:** Individual support and regular feedback to promote your personal and professional development
* **Central location:** A modern workplace in the heart of Berlin with excellent public transport connections
* **Team culture:** An open, dynamic team with flat hierarchies, regular team events and an appreciative atmosphere
* **Remuneration:** Attractive and fair pay for the duration of your internship
  

  

This position is also available on a part-time basis.

Severely disabled people are given priority if they are equally qualified.

title: Venture Development - Intern
description:
**About Us**
Founded in Berlin,
**autarc**
is a ~80-person start-up that graduated from Y Combinator in San Francisco. Our team spans Sales, Tech, and Operations. We build software that helps energy installers plan, sell, and deliver home electrification projects faster and with higher quality.
  
  
**Your Impact**
Are you excited to work on strategic projects that accelerate the energy transition?
  
  
If you're excited about green-tech, cross-functional projects, and exploring scalable solutions, join us and make an impact.
  
  
You will work closely with the co-founder, our Venture Development Lead whilst collaborating with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Tech to drive new initiatives from idea to launch. This role is built for someone who likes ownership, moves fast, and learns directly from customers.
  
  
Please note: This position is
**on-site in Berlin (Mitte) and C2-level proficiency in German is required.**
What you’ll do
  
  

* Own early product management and cross-team execution for new initiatives: shape value propositions, define MVPs, prioritize features, align stakeholders, and coordinate Sales, Marketing, and Tech for fast, smooth launches
* Dive quickly into new topics, markets, and customer problems, building a deep understanding through frequent, direct customer conversations
* Hands-on drive the launch of new digital products and services - from first idea to market rollout - working closely with the co-founders and team
* Talk to customers daily to uncover pain points, validate solutions, and actively promote, position, and upsell new products and features while iterating based on real-world feedback
* Support go-to-market execution with sales decks, presentations, and customer-facing materials, and help the team communicate new value clearly
* Work closely with Product and Design to translate market/customer requirements into concrete product improvements and launch assets

**What You Bring**

* Graduated from a strong university; entrepreneurial mindset
* Fluent in English and C2 German (required)
* Experience in a startup environment (or similarly fast-paced setting)
* Hands-on: you execute, not just coordinate
* Curious about how tech, operations, and business strategy come together in high-growth companies
* Structured thinker who’s not afraid to get into details, run the numbers, and execute fast
* Based in Berlin and willing to work on-site (office in Mitte) for min. 5 months

**What We Offer**

* Freedom to choose your own equipment
* An annual team retreat
* The choice between Dance or Deutschland Ticket for mobility
* Urban Sports Club for fitness
* Regular team events, lunches and activities

**Next steps**
If your application is successful, you will participate in the following:
  
  

* Screening call with Venture Deveopment Lead
* Culture fit call with Thies (Co-Founder)
* Take home case study (approx. 1 hour)
* Final on-site interview with the team

**About Us**
Heating our buildings causes around 25% of Europe's CO₂ emissions. Decarbonizing it depends on installers – and there are far too few of them to keep up with the growing demand for heat pumps.
  
  
autarc is building the operating system for energy installers across Europe: software that makes planning, designing and installing heat pumps faster and more digital. Our goal is to help plan and design 1 million heat pumps by 2030.
  
  
Founded in Berlin and backed by Y Combinator (S24), we're a team of 60+ people across Sales, Tech and Operations, already serving more than 2,000 customers.

title: Werkstudent (w/m/d) KI-gestützte Software- und Plattformentwicklung
description:
**Gemeinsam machen wir den Unterschied**
**Siemens Mobility**
ist ein eigenständig geführtes Unternehmen der Siemens AG und seit über 160 Jahren ein führender Anbieter im Bereich Mobilität. Zu unserem Kerngeschäft gehören Schienenfahrzeuge, Bahnautomatisierungs- und Elektrifizierungslösungen, schlüsselfertige Systeme sowie die dazugehörigen Serviceleistungen. Wir waren schon immer sehr innovativ, um Reisen schneller, sicherer und komfortabler zu machen. Heute brauchen wir neue Lösungen für neue Herausforderungen wie den Klimawandel und weltweit steigende Bevölkerungszahlen. Das ist es, was uns antreibt. Deshalb gestalten wir Mobilität mit Leidenschaft und sind immer einen Schritt voraus. Durch Digitalisierung machen wir Infrastrukturen intelligent und schaffen Möglichkeiten, die uns nachhaltig und nahtlos von A nach B bringen. Unsere über 40.000 Mitarbeitenden sind Pioniere im Mobilitätswesen, die dabei helfen, die Welt in Bewegung zu halten.
  
  
**Was trägst Du bei?**
Du möchtest neben dem Studium einen Einblick in ein Entwicklungs- und Plattformteam gewinnen und herausfinden, wie KI sinnvoll für die Entwicklung in großen Organisationen eingesetzt werden kann? In unserem Team arbeitest du an der Weiterentwicklung von Anwendungen und Services im Bereich Softwareentwicklung und KI. Dabei kannst du eigene Ideen einbringen und bekommst viele Gelegenheiten, Dich auch mit KI, DevOps und Cloud-Technologien zu beschäftigen.
  
  
Hierfür suchen wir einen Werkstudenten (w/m/d) für den Standort Braunschweig und einen Werkstudenten (w/m/d) für den Standort Berlin.
  
  

* Bei uns entwickelst und pflegst Du Software- und Plattformkomponenten. Dabei arbeitest du hauptsächlich mit Rust oder Python, gegebenenfalls auch mit anderen Sprachen wie Go oder JavaScript.
* Du unterstützt bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung neuer Funktionen sowie bei der Behebung von Fehlern.
* Du lernst, Systeme zu entwickeln und KI-Agenten für die Softwareentwicklung zu orchestrieren.
* Du tauschst Dich im Team über technische Ansätze aus und bringst Verbesserungsvorschläge ein.
* Je nach Interesse und Projektbedarf wirkst Du an KI-Anwendungen, automatisierten Entwicklungsabläufen oder Cloud-Themen mit.

**Was bringst Du mit?**

* Du studierst Informatik oder Software-Engineering und kannst uns längerfristig unterstützen.
* Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit Rust oder Python, zum Beispiel durch Projekte, Praktika oder Deine bisherige Arbeit. Alternativ kannst Du sehr gute Kenntnisse in einer anderen Programmiersprache vorweisen.
* Du hast erste Berührungspunkte mit DevOps-Techniken, zum Beispiel CI/CD, Containerisierung oder Automatisierung gesammelt.
* Vorteilhaft sind zudem erste Erfahrungen mit den gängigen KI-Anwendungen, etwa mit Machine Learning, Sprachmodellen und KI-APIs.
* Des Weiteren sind Kenntnisse in Cloud-Technologien, insbesondere im Open-Source-Bereich (z.B. Kubernetes, Docker, GitLab und Terraform/OpenTofu), ein Plus.
* Gute Deutsch- und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab.

**Was bieten wir Dir?**
Inklusion & Vielfalt
  
  
Bei Siemens Mobility setzen wir uns engagiert für Gerechtigkeit und Gleichberechtigung ein. Vielfalt bereichert unser Team und fördert innovative Lösungen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung.
  
  
Purpose
  
  
Wir sind Pioniere der Mobilität. Bei uns trägst Du in einem Zukunftsmarkt aktiv zu Verkehrswende und Klimaschutz bei, weil unsere Transportlösungen in aller Welt den CO2-Ausstoß verringern.
  
  
Mobiles Arbeiten /Remote Working
  
  
Bei uns hast Du die Möglichkeit, hybrid zu arbeiten. Das bedeutet, dass Du zu einem erheblichen Anteil mobil tätig sein kannst. Dies haben wir durch eine Betriebsvereinbarung offiziell geregelt.
  
  
Attraktive Konditionen
  
  
Bei uns erhältst Du eine attraktive Vergütung. Du startest mit circa 15 € je Stunde und erhältst ab dem 7. Monat circa 19 €.
  
  
Eine Übersicht über unsere Benefits findest Du hier.
  
  
**Wie trittst Du mit uns in Kontakt?**
**www.siemens.de/mobility**
wenn Du vor Deiner Bewerbung mehr über Siemens Mobility erfahren möchtest.
  
  
**www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/faq.html**
wenn Du Informationen rund um das Thema Bewerbung mittels unseres FAQ’s einholen möchtest.
  
  
**+49 (9131) 17 5243-0**
wenn Du über unsere Bewerberhotline weitere Fragen zur Stelle klären möchtest.
  
  
**www.siemens.com/mobility-jobs**
wenn Du mehr Informationen zu Jobs & Karriere bei Siemens erhalten möchtest.
  
  
Wir legen Wert auf Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung.
  
  
Ansprechpartner für diese Stellenausschreibung ist Frau Christin Hitz.

**A Day in Your Life at Atotech Deutschland GmbH & Co. KG**

As a Working Student (m/f/d) Data Scientist and Programmer, you will partner with R&D engineers and internal stakeholders to develop a user-friendly desktop graphical user interface for FASET, an existing statistical analysis backend for copper surface facet evaluation. You will integrate existing C/C++ functionality into an application and support efficient, reproducible analysis, visualization, data handling, and export. In this role, you will report to the responsible manager within R&D Electronics.

**You Will Make an Impact By**

* Analyzing the existing C/C++ FASET core code and integrating it into a desktop GUI
* Translating user requirements into functional specifications and intuitive software workflows
* Developing and testing front-end functions for parameter input, image visualization, mapping, optimization, and results review
* Implementing asynchronous program execution, project data management, metadata handling, logging, configuration, and file handling
* Improving the performance of computationally intensive analysis and coordinate-mapping functions
* Creating clean, maintainable, version-controlled, and well-documented code

**Skills You Bring**

* Enrolled student (m/f/d) in computer science, data science, or a comparable technical degree program
* Programming knowledge
* Basic experience with graphical user interfaces
* Understanding of software development, testing, debugging, and version control
* Analytical thinking and the ability to understand scientific or engineering workflows
* Good written and spoken English; German skills are beneficial

title: Tax & Finance Operations Interns (f/m/d) - AI Tax Startup
description:
We are building Germany's leading Tax Advisory firm. Taxforce was founded based on a simple observation: Many business owners want a tax advisor who acts as a true sparring partner: proactive, responsive, and strategic. What they often get instead is a service provider: booking receipts and filing tax returns, with little real advisory.

We’re building the alternative.

Founded in 2025, Taxforce rethinks tax advisory from the ground up: AI-powered and highly automated, yet personal. We’re starting with healthcare professionals, a complex and underserved segment, with the ambition to expand into many more industries over time.

Instead of pure compliance, we deliver real advisory and become long-term partners to our clients: from initial setup to established organizations.

This is a €40B market in Germany alone, with processes that have barely changed in decades. AI is now enabling a fundamental shift and there are no playbooks yet. We’re writing them.

We’re a small, highly ambitious team in Berlin, backed by €5M from Tenet VC and founded by alumni of Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company and the former Klarna Head of Engineering. You’ll work directly with the founders, take on real responsibility from day one, and see how AI transforms a real-world industry.

We offer a high-ownership environment, direct feedback and mentoring, a collaborative team, and competitive salary all from our office near Boxhagener Platz.

Join early and help us redefine tax advisory.

**Tasks**
---------

**As a Tax & Finance Intern, you'll work right in the middle of our operational and advisory tax work**. You'll take on responsibility from day one, both **e**xternally, supporting our tax advisors, and internally, in our own controlling and bookkeeping along the entire value chain: from preparing client tax returns and hands-on research, to managing invoicing, funds, and cashflow, through our monthly internal financial close. Because tech and tax work together at Taxforce, you'll be close to the point where manual work turns into automation and you'll actively help us make our processes better: :

**Finance & controlling**

* Take ownership of our invoicing and support funds and cashflow management
* Support the monthly internal bookkeeping and financial close
* Build and maintain reporting and controlling analyses over time

**Tax Operational work**

* Prepare ongoing financial accounting: receipt capture, booking, account reconciliation
* Prepare annual financial statement packages and business analyses: Provide simple input on tax returns and pre-filings (income tax, business taxes) at draft level, where you get feedback and develop new skills
* Support our digital mail and tax assessment processing through deadline control and smart document classification
* Structured client communication (document requests, follow-ups)
* Maintain client master data and support deadline contro

**Tech & automation**

* Test and document internal tools and workflows
* Contribute to automating recurring tasks (e.g. document classification, data extraction, integrations)
* Data preparation and simple analyses

**Requirements**
----------------

* **Drive & ambition:** You're excited to work motivated to work in a young team and thrive in fast-paced startup environments.
* **Relevant studies:** You're studying business administration, economics, law, tax or a related field, ideally with a focus on or strong interest in tax, accounting or finance
* **First practical experience:** You've gained hands-on experience through internships or working student roles (ideally in Tax, Accounting, Finance or Consulting)
* **Care & accuracy:** You work carefully and precisely, because in tax and finance every detail counts
* **Structured & independent:** You organise yourself well, prioritise between tasks and get things done without needing everything spelled out
* **Tech-savvy:** You're comfortable using AI tools and can implement small automations yourself and you have no problem with learning new tools and skills on the go
* **Collaborative:** You are a team player. Working together as a team and sharing knowledge comes naturally to you
* **German language skills:** We are a fast growing start-up with a diverse team. However, our customers do mostly speak German. Hence we require German language skills.

**Benefits**
------------

* **Learn from an experienced team:** Work closely with founders and tax advisors and get direct feedback and mentoring from day one
* **Ownership from day one**: Take on real responsibility early and help shape how Taxforce is built across tax, finance, and operations
* **Front-row seat to AI in the real world**: See how AI is applied to transform a traditional industry and actively contribute to building an AI-driven product
* **Steep learning curve:** Work on real clients and real numbers, not example cases, and build skills that carry into your career
* **Strong team environment**: Join an ambitious, supportive team with direct feedback and a high level of trust and ownership
* **Fair working student salary and a great office:** Competitive pay and flexible hours around your studies, from our office near Boxhagener Platz

**Office Policy:** We work 5 days in the office, because we feel that is crucial to enable speed, learning, and compounding interests when working next to each other.

description:
**Working Student Master Data Management (m/w/d)**
==================================================

**Field of Work:** Data Management,
  
**Location:** Berlin  
**Legal Entity:** KWS Berlin GmbH  
**Contract Type:** Temporary  
**Is Full Time:** No  
**Job ID:** 16983

**KWS Berlin GmbH** is looking for a **Working Student - Master Data Management Materials & Production Master(m/f/d).** In this role, you will support the Master Data Management team in maintaining master data in the areas of the business (materials, production, logistics and purchasing) while adhering to standards and governance to ensure data is compliant with defined information, policies, and quality requirements as defined by the data owner.

This opportunity is **20 hours/week for 12 months** with possibility for extension.

**Your Tasks:**

* Create and maintain standard operating procedures and training documentation and perform end-user training.
* Complete tasks in work queue as assigned according to agreed SLA.
* Initiate and carry out regular data cleansing activities to ensure high level data quality, compliance and consistency of master data.
* Identify, report and resolve data quality issues through root cause analysis.
* Support and implement data management methodologies that support KWS business initiatives.
* Participate in cross-functional projects and initiatives.
* Support in ad-hoc request from the team related to master data.

**Your Profile:**

* Enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Business Management, Finance, Supply Chain or any other related field, with **a minimum of 2 semesters left of studies;**
* Understanding impact of master data management – first experience in the area is a plus;
* Strong interest in Data Management;
* Proficiency in MS Office products, including advanced use of MS Excel. Power BI knowledge is an advantage;
* SAP experience is an advantage (PP module in S/4HANA);
* Proactive, structured, and an eye for details.
* Strong interpersonal, verbal/written communication and organization skills;
* Process-driven team player with customer-oriented service attitude;
* **Fluent English**, any other language is an advantage;
* Located in Berlin/Brandenburg.

**Our offer:**

* A thorough introduction to our processes;
* A location in the heart of Berlin;
* A positive and appreciative working environment;
* Flat hierarchies and open communication;
* Hybrid working possible (40% remote), attractive remuneration and flexible working hours to accommodate your studies;
* Insight into material and production master data management.

We look forward to receiving your online application via our application system SuccessFactors! Please use the "Apply" function in the online advertisement.

KWS is one of the world’s leading plant breeding companies and employs around 5,000 employees in more than 70 countries. At KWS, diversity is not just a value; it is an essential part of our success. Breeding resilient crops requires diversity; likewise, our strength comes from the diversity of our teams. Whatever your background or identity is, we invite you to join us.

Further information: www.kws.com/careers/. Follow us on LinkedIn® at https://linkedin.com/company/kwsgroup/.
