title: Mandatory Internship – Product Development Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
**About ecopals**
-----------------

ecopals is building the leading performance additive platform for asphalt and bitumen modification, engineered for regional, sovereign supply chains and backed by strong unit economics. Our current product line is built on high-performance polymers, with further additive categories in active development. In the last two years, we have scaled to active operations in more than 10 EU countries, while continuously expanding our product and technology platform.

As we enter our next growth phase, we are opening a mandatory internship position for **Product Development Engineer (m/f/d)**. The role works closely with our R&D team on the identification, assessment and development of new products, formulations and production routes.

The role combines materials science and engineering with data analysis and modern AI-assisted technical workflows, with a strong emphasis on using these tools to accelerate development without compromising scientific rigor.

**Tasks**
---------

In this internship, you will help turn early technical ideas into structured development programmes and support the evaluation of which product and process routes are worth pursuing.

**Areas of responsibility**

* **Product development research.** Researching potential development routes for new products, formulations and processes based on scientific literature, technical documentation, experimental results and first-principles understanding.
* **Development-route assessment.** Comparing materials, technologies, mechanisms and production concepts and identifying promising routes for further development.
* **Technical and economic feasibility.** Preparing structured assessments and reports on technical feasibility, process requirements, raw materials, costs and potential economic viability.
* **Test programme development.** Supporting the design of experimental programmes, including formulation matrices, variables, testing methods and evaluation criteria.
* **Experimental and laboratory support.** Preparing material samples for internal testing, external laboratories and customers; assisting with the preparation and execution of in-house experimental setups; and supporting the documentation and evaluation of experimental results.
* **Laboratory coordination.** Supporting the planning and coordination of testing activities with internal and external laboratories, suppliers and technical partners.
* **Data analysis.** Processing and evaluating experimental data to identify trends, correlations, performance drivers and development priorities.
* **Technical data management.** Building and maintaining structured databases for formulations, raw materials, test results, literature and development projects.
* **Programming, data analysis and AI-assisted workflows.** Using Python and modern AI-assisted development tools, including AI agents, to clean, structure, analyse and visualize technical data; automate repetitive R&D tasks; support technical research; and build internal analytical workflows. A key part of the role is learning to use these tools effectively and responsibly, with proper validation, documentation and control of the resulting work.
* **Technical standards and regulations.** Researching and analysing standards, specifications and regulatory requirements relevant to products under development and their potential applications.
* **Technical reporting.** Preparing clear technical reports and decision documents that translate scientific, experimental and economic information into actionable development recommendations.
* **Independent development work.** Taking ownership of defined development questions and following them from initial research through analysis and experimental validation.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Currently completing a **Master’s degree or comparable advanced university programme** in **Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Process Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering** or a related field.
* Good foundations in **chemistry, materials science, construction materials and/or industrial processes**.
* **At least two years of relevant experience in one or more of the activities described above**, gained through internships, research projects, student assistant positions, laboratory work, industrial projects or professional experience.
* Strong analytical skills and confidence working with quantitative technical and experimental data.
* **Programming and data-analysis skills**, preferably with Python or comparable tools. Previous experience with AI-assisted coding or AI agents is valuable but not required. More important is the ability and willingness to rapidly adopt these workflows and use them rigorously — understanding what the tools are doing, checking their outputs, identifying errors and ensuring that analyses remain technically sound and reproducible.
* Ability to work systematically with scientific literature, experimental results and complex technical information.
* Ability to move between fundamental scientific questions and practical engineering and production constraints.
* A structured and independent way of working, with a strong sense of ownership.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; German is a plus.
* An entrepreneurial and pragmatic mindset, with genuine interest in developing technologies that can move from research into industrial application.

**Your Benefits**
-----------------

* **Direct involvement in product development**, contributing to technologies that may become future ecopals products.
* **Exposure to the full development process**, from scientific principles and formulation concepts to processes, testing and economic assessment.
* **Practical experimental experience**, supporting material preparation, in-house experiments and laboratory validation activities.
* **Hands-on experience with technical data and analytical tools**, including opportunities to improve how R&D data is structured, analysed and used for decision making.
* **Practical experience with AI-assisted R&D workflows**, including programming, automation and diligent use of AI agents as technical working tools.
* **Proximity to decision making**, working closely with R&D and company leadership on which development routes to pursue.
* **Responsibility from an early stage**, with ownership of defined technical work packages and development questions.
* **A steep learning curve** across materials science, chemistry, industrial processes, data analysis and applied R&D.
* **Practical exposure to industrial R&D**, including collaboration with laboratories, suppliers and technical partners.
* **Meaningful impact**, contributing to technologies designed to reduce emissions, improve circularity and increase the performance of critical infrastructure.

This position is a **mandatory internship**. A corresponding confirmation from your academic institution, stating the requirement to complete an internship, must be provided prior to the start of the internship.

Sounds like you? We look forward to receiving your application, including your CV and cover letter.

title: Securities Operations Intern (f/m/d)
description:
**About Us:**

At Upvest, we are on a **mission to make investing as easy as spending money**. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by **€280M in total funding** from world-class investors, including **BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive**. Our latest **€105M funding round in March 2026** - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

**About the role:**

In 2027, Upvest is launching the **PEA (Plan d'Épargne en Actions)** on the French market with several leading fintechs. Within the Settlements & Transfers team, you will work across the full post-trade chain of securities account and PEA transfers: from instruction processing to settlement at Euroclear France, including relations with account keepers, custodians and issuers.

This internship offers **direct exposure to French and European post-trade operations** during a product launch, with real responsibilities from your first weeks.

**What you’ll do:**

* **Incoming and outgoing transfers:** Handle securities account (CTO) and PEA transfers with banks and brokers in France and across Europe, from receipt of the request to settlement of securities and cash.
* **Counterparty and client relations:** Ensure smooth communication with counterparties (banks, brokers, custodians) and our clients, and drive the follow-up of requests and reminders.
* **Controls and reconciliation:** Check securities and cash positions, reconcile movements with our custodian and analyse breaks.
* **Fails and exception management:** Investigate unsettled or rejected instructions, identify the root cause and coordinate resolution with counterparties and internal teams.
* **PEA tax continuity:** Review and record PEA tax statements (bordereaux d'information) to ensure the plan's tax history is fully preserved.
* **Registered shares:** Process operations on French registered shares (conversions, de/registrations).
* **Reporting and continuous improvement:** actively monitor SLAs and KPIs, write operating procedures and identify automation opportunities.

**What you bring:**

* **Education:** Master's degree (M1 or M2) in Finance, Banking, Economics or Law from a business school, engineering school or university; gap-year students and recent Master's graduates able to sign an internship agreement are welcome.
* **Languages: You have native-level or bilingual proficiency in French (C2) and are comfortable working in English.**
* **Experience:** A first experience in banking, back office, middle office or securities operations is a strong plus, as is knowledge of the PEA, post-trade or Euroclear France.
* **Analytical mindset:** Rigour, attention to detail and a taste for solving complex problems.
* **Tools:** You're confident with spreadsheets ; knowledge SQL/Python is a plus.

**How we Upvest in you:**

* **Impact-driven work:** We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.
* **Team celebrations:** Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.
* **Inclusion**: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem Black at Upvest, Up&Out, and UpVergent.

**Our Values:**

* **Make it easy for others.** We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions
* **Own the outcome.** We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.
* **Rise to the challenge.** We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.
* **Tell the story.** We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: (Junior) Growth Associate (m/f/d)
description:
We are on the mission to build Europe’s leading energy management platform **to provide fair, clean energy to everyone.**

We’re a diverse team of **50+ employees**, with **46% being female** and from **16+ nationalities**, and steadily growing. Having **raised of over €40 M** in total, we are looking for passionate people to join us on our mission!

Wir haben eine klare Mission: Wir bauen Europas führende Plattform für Energiemanagement, um **faire und saubere Energie für alle** zugänglich zu machen.

Unser Team ist vielfältig – wir sind über **50 Personen** aus mehr als **16 Nationalitäten**, mit einem **Frauenanteil von 46 %**. Und wir wachsen weiter!  
Mit über **40 Mio. € an Finanzierung** suchen wir nach motivierten Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns die Energiezukunft gestalten wollen.

**What You'll Do**

* Manage day-to-day operations and key account relationships with our sales partners, ensuring smooth collaboration and ongoing support
* Plan and coordinate sales campaigns with partners to drive customer acquisition and channel performance
* Manage the rollout of new offers & partners across the direct sales channel
* Improve existing processes, reporting, and performance tracking to make channel operations more efficient and scalable
* Support other acquisition channels and cross-functional growth initiatives as needed, acting as a versatile all-rounder within the Growth team **in Berlin**

  **What We're Looking For**
* 0–2 years of experience in Growth, Sales Operations, Business Development, Account Management, or a similar field (relevant internships or working student experience count!)
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and projects simultaneously
* An analytical mindset and confidence working with data, reporting, and operational processes
* A proactive, hands-on attitude with a strong sense of ownership and a willingness to take initiative
* A proactive mindset towards using AI and automation to improve efficiency, while being mindful of potential risks and limitations
* German Native and good English skills (C1/C2)

**About Us**
============

We’re Germany’s fastest-growing digital green energy provider and a Certified B Corp , driving the energy transition by making renewable energy more accessible and inclusive.

How? Through variable tariffs, dynamic pricing, smart EV charging, heat pump and solar optimization, and Germany’s first virtual power plant: NeoGrid.

At Ostrom, you’ll work in a dynamic, open environment where you can be yourself, take on challenges, and grow both personally and professionally.

**Environmental Impact:** Each customer who switches to Ostrom on average helps offset 1.5 tons of CO2 emissions per year compared to the average German energy mix.

**VSOP:** On top of offering a competitive salary you will have access to company shares to ensure you can truly be part of the journey.

**Trust-based Team**: A truly flat hierarchy and transparent company culture, where everyone’s voice matters.

**Benefits**: An annual learning budget, company-pension scheme, company events, discounted USC membership, discounted BVG public transport ticket, e-bike or e-moped, exclusive discounts via FutureBens or monthly vouchers - the choice is yours.

**Stay In The Loop:** We believe in transparent communication — from weekly town halls and quarterly updates to regular retrospectives. Got feedback or an idea? We’re all ears.

**Work Together, Celebrate Together:** We thrive on collaboration. Wins are shared and so are the celebrations from monthly happy hours to team trips and company events.

**Work Your Way:** Whether you prefer the office, your home desk, or a sunny spot in Sardinia — you work where you work best.

**Learn By Doing:** We grow together with personal development paths, learning budgets, and regular knowledge-sharing sessions. Try things out, learn along the way, and keep moving forward.

**Über Uns**
============

Wir sind der am schnellsten wachsende digitale Ökostromanbieter mit B Corp Zertifizierung in Deutschland – und treiben die Energiewende aktiv voran. Unser Ziel: Erneuerbare Energie für alle zugänglich und inklusiv machen.

Wie? Mit variablen Tarifen, dynamischem Strompreis, Smart EV Charging, Optimierung von Wärmepumpen und Solaranlagen sowie Deutschlands erstem virtuellen Kraftwerk: NeoGrid.

Bei Ostrom arbeitest du in einem offenen, dynamischen Umfeld, in dem du du selbst sein kannst, Herausforderungen annimmst und dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickelst.

**Nachhaltigkeit, die zählt:** Mit deinem Wechsel zu Ostrom unterstützt du aktiv die Energiewende. Unsere Kund\*innen helfen im Schnitt, jährlich 1,5 Tonnen CO₂ gegenüber dem deutschen Durchschnittsstrommix einzusparen.

**Wertschätzung, die sich auszahlt:** Neben einem attraktiven Gehalt erhältst du bei uns VSOPs – Unternehmensanteile, mit denen du direkt am Erfolg von Ostrom beteiligt bist.

**Teamkultur auf Augenhöhe:** Bei Ostrom leben wir flache Hierarchien und eine offene Feedbackkultur. Deine Meinung zählt – vom ersten Tag an.

**Benefits:** Du erhältst ein flexibles Paket mit vielen Extras – von einem jährlichen Weiterbildungsbudget, über eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge, bis hin zu einer vergünstigten USC-Mitgliedschaft, einem vergünstigten BVG Jobticket oder deinem eigenen E-Bike bzw. E-Roller und sowie Rabattcodes über FutureBens. Alternativ wählst du monatliche Gutscheine – du entscheidest, was dir wichtig ist.

**Transparenz:** Ob in wöchentlichen Townhalls, vierteljährlichen Updates oder offenen Retrospektiven – wir glauben an klare Kommunikation und kontinuierlichen Austausch.

**Erfolge feiern wir gemeinsam:** Teamarbeit steht bei uns im Mittelpunkt – und genauso feiern wir auch unsere Erfolge: mit regelmäßigen Happy Hours, Team-Ausflügen und unvergesslichen Company Events.

**Work you way:** Ob im Berliner Büro, im Homeoffice oder remote unter der Sonne – bei uns arbeitest du dort, wo du am produktivsten bist.

**Wachse mit uns:** Persönliche Entwicklung ist bei Ostrom keine Floskel. Wir unterstützen dich mit Lernbudgets und Raum zum Ausprobieren – damit du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln kannst.

title: Associate Consultant (m/w/d) – Digital Products & Connected Car
description:
Beschreibung
  
  
Du willst dort anpacken, wo es wirklich zählt – und an Projekten arbeiten, die direkten Einfluss auf strategische Entscheidungen in der Industrie haben?
  
  
Bei DRIVE Consulting unterstützt du führende Industrie- und Automotive-Unternehmen dabei, komplexe Herausforderungen entlang der Wertschöpfungskette zu lösen. Du arbeitest an spannenden Fragestellungen in Transformations- und Beratungsprojekten und trägst dazu bei, gemeinsam mit deinem Team nachhaltige und wirkungsvolle Lösungen für unsere Kunden zu entwickeln.
  
  
Unsere Projekte bewegen sich in zentralen Zukunftsfeldern – von zukunftsweisenden Produktionsstrategien, modernen Produktionssystemen und Digital Manufacturing bis hin zur Entwicklung innovativer digitaler Produkte und Services. Wenn dich also Themen rund um Smart Factory, Robotics, Connected Car, Autonomous Driving und datengetriebene Lösungen mit Data & AI interessieren, bist du bei uns genau richtig.
  
  
Dabei geht unser Anspruch über klassische Konzeptarbeit hinaus: Wir begleiten unsere Kunden von der ersten Analyse über die Konzeption bis hin zur Umsetzung und sorgen so dafür, dass aus Strategien messbarer Impact entsteht.
  
  
Du unterstützt in dieser Rolle Projekte entlang des gesamten Projektverlaufs und gewinnst dabei früh Verantwortung. Dabei arbeitest du gemeinsam mit deinem Team an konzeptionellen und umsetzungsnahen Fragestellungen und bist eng in die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden und Projektbeteiligten eingebunden.
  
  
Deine Aufgaben
  
  

* Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit deinem Team in Beratungsprojekten rund um digitale Produkte, Services und Connected Car Lösungen und übernimmst erste eigene Arbeitspakete
* Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Markt-, Kunden- und Technologietrends und strukturierst komplexe Fragestellungen im Kontext digitaler Geschäftsmodelle
* Du arbeitest an der Entwicklung innovativer Konzepte für digitale Produkte und Services – z. B. für vernetzte Funktionen oder neue Geschäftsmodelle
* Du wirkst an der Konkretisierung und Umsetzung dieser Konzepte mit, z. B. in den Bereichen Feature-Definition, Use Cases, Customer Journeys oder Service-Design
* Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Business, Technologie und Kunde und unterstützt bei der Abstimmung mit internen und externen Projektbeteiligten
* Du bereitest Ergebnisse adressatengerecht auf und entwickelst klare, überzeugende Präsentationen für unsere Kunden
* Du wirkst im Projektmanagement mit und erhältst Einblicke in die Steuerung von Projekten entlang von Zeit, Qualität und Kosten
* Du erhältst Einblicke in unterschiedliche Themenfelder und Practices und baust dir durch die Projektarbeit ein breites fachliches Profil auf

Dein Profil
  
  

* Du hast dein technisches oder wirtschaftswissenschaftliches Studium hervorragend abgeschlossen
* Du bringst erste relevante Praxiserfahrung z. B. durch Praktika oder Werkstudententätigkeiten in der Beratung, im Automotive-Umfeld oder im Bereich digitaler Produkte / Services mit
* Du verfügst über ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten und strukturierst komplexe Fragestellungen klar und nachvollziehbar
* Du denkst innovativ und entwickelst fundierte Lösungen für anspruchsvolle Problemstellungen
* Du überzeugst durch klare Kommunikation und ein sicheres Auftreten im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern
* Du arbeitest gerne im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und bringst eigene Ideen aktiv ein
* Du zeichnest dich durch eine hohe Einsatzbereitschaft und einen strukturierten, lösungsorientierten Arbeitsstil aus

Unser Angebot an dich
  
  
Bei DRIVE Consulting triffst du auf ein junges, wachsendes Team, dessen Herz für technische Beratungsprojekte in der Industrie schlägt – insbesondere im Automotive-Umfeld.
  
  
Dich erwartet ein Umfeld mit hohem fachlichen Anspruch, steiler Lernkurve und individueller Weiterentwicklung. Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen zusammen, übernimmst schrittweise Verantwortung für eigene Themen und entwickelst deine fachlichen und methodischen Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich weiter. Offenheit, Vertrauen und Teamspirit prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit – in einem motivierten Team mit klarer Umsetzungsorientierung.
  
  
**Außerdem Erwarten Dich**

* Individuelles Coaching und persönliches Buddy-Programm für deinen Einstieg und deine kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung
* Dienstwagen oder Jobrad bzw. Jobticket – flexibel nach deinen Bedürfnissen
* Täglicher Lunch-Zuschuss, kostenlose Snacks und Getränke sowie ein regelmäßiges gemeinsames Frühstück im Office
* EGYM Wellpass für vielfältige Fitness- und Gesundheitsangebote sowie attraktive Mitarbeitervorteile über Corporate Benefits
* Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, ein monatliches Spendenbudget, über 30 Tage Urlaub sowie Sabbatical-Optionen

**Und für uns besonders wichtig:**
Erfolge werden bei uns auch gemeinsam gefeiert – bei regelmäßigen Teamevents und größeren, bereichsübergreifenden Firmenevents.
  
  
Über uns
  
  
**DRIVE Consulting GmbH**
ist eine Unternehmensberatung mit Hauptsitz in Aachen sowie Standorten in München, Berlin, Peking und Shanghai. Unser Herz schlägt für technische Beratungsprojekte mit Fokus auf die Automobil- und Industriebranche. Zu unseren Kunden zählen sowohl deutsche Premium OEMs als auch junge, aufstrebende Automobilhersteller sowie große und mittelständische Industrieunternehmen.
  
  
Unser Name steht für unseren klaren Fokus auf die Mobilitätsbranche und repräsentiert gleichzeitig unseren Spirit – denn wir sind ein Team, in dem jede\*r Einzelne DRIVE hat.
  
  
Wir stehen unseren Kunden als Wegbereiter ins Unbekannte und als Katalysator für Innovationen zur Seite. Denn wir sind überzeugt, dass man nur mit dem Mut, neue Wege einzuschlagen, einzigartige Erfolgsgeschichten schreiben kann.
  
  
Wir schlagen Brücken zwischen kleinen Ideenschmieden und großen Konzernen sowie zwischen Management und Technologieexpert\*innen.
  
  
Durch den engen und partnerschaftlichen Austausch mit unseren Kunden entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte und individuelle Lösungen. Ein entscheidender Erfolgsfaktor ist dabei unser einzigartiges Partnernetzwerk aus Industrie und Forschung. Dank unserer Nähe zu namhaften Universitäten wie der RWTH Aachen verbinden wir Wissenschaft und Praxis.
  
  
**Begeisterung wird bei uns großgeschrieben**
und bestimmt unseren Arbeitsalltag – denn sie ist der beste Antrieb.

title: Working Student- Engineering (m/f/d)
description:
#### **About us**

Today, 7 out of 10 people globally lack access to life-saving Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI). Conventional MRI machines are massive, cost millions of euros, and require specialized, shielded rooms which means they are usually confined to large hospitals.

At DeepSpin, we are changing that by building the World’s First Flatbed MRI.

Our open-architecture scanner plugs into a standard wall socket, fits into regular doctor's offices, and costs 10x less than conventional systems.

Backed by globally leading VCs, we are expanding our team in Berlin. This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven team bringing an essential medical technology to the billions of people who currently cannot afford it.

#### **About Position**

At DeepSpin, you will be supporting the R&D team. As a working student in Engineering, you will be part of our rapidly growing team with 20 h/week in a variety of tasks including:

* Participate in the assembly and construction of electromechanical components for our MRI prototype.
* Collaborate with team members to ensure components meet design specifications.
* Assist in troubleshooting and diagnosing issues with custom-built components and systems.
* Work closely with engineers to identify root causes of problems and implement effective solutions.
* Assist in the procurement,sourcing and quality management of electromechanical components for our MRI system
* Research and evaluate potential suppliers and vendors.

#### **Requirements**

* Student of Electronics / Mechatronics Engineering or a comparable course of study, with residence in Berlin
* Excellent communication skills and a proactive get-stuff-done attitude
* First principles thinking when diagnosing problems and applying research to a commercial setting
* Passion for impactful projects and for revolutionising the healthcare market with us
* Preferred: experience in a lab-like setting: designing, measuring and troubleshooting complex technical solutions

#### **What we offer**

* Dynamic & Innovative Culture: A creative workplace with flat hierarchies and open communication among a highly skilled collaborative team
* International environment: A diverse and multicultural English-first office with more than 10 different nationalities driven by the same purpose, to revolutionize medical imaging
* Benefits: Urban Sports Club, BVG and lifestyle vouchers along with company-sponsored lunch in our penthouse office and monthly team events
* Personal development: In addition to learning on the job through mentorship and high responsibility from the start, we encourage and support personal development (trainings, certifications etc.)
* Work-life balance: Flexible working hours + 30 days of paid leave per year and Parental leaves.

title: Growth Product Owner (DE)
description:
****What does Nodes & Links do?****

Did you know that an ancient Roman Aqueduct initially cost 12 million sesterces but ended up costing more than 30 million? Big projects have always been problematic to humanity - we want to fix that.

We are developing an AI-first SaaS platform to help people who deal with very large projects. If someone is building a nuclear plant or a data center, they need a special kind of software to organize and prioritize their work. 👋That's us.

Recognized by TechNation, Construction Tech Review, and Amazon as industry leaders, we're part of Oxford University's Creative Destruction Lab and Entrepreneur First alumni, with awards from CIR, CogX, and the British Construction Industry. Our global clients include Intel, AECOM, and BAM, and we've raised $30M to date from top VC funds.

This is a great opportunity to join an ambitious deep-tech start-up in a dynamic and mission-driven environment, driving our growth from a start-up to a scale-up 🚀

You will also be helping to solve one of the oldest problems of mankind and potentially save the economy billions - not bad right? 🤘

****📣 What will you do in the role?****

We are looking for a Growth Product Owner that will own a portfolio of screens that shapes how some of the largest projects in the world get delivered. 

You will have end-to-end ownership, from scope creation to design prototypes that Engineers can directly pick for build. This ownership ensures you can directly express your vision on what problem to solve fast and efficiently. We embrace human direction and accountability with heavy AI tooling - you will work with new ways today, the way everyone else will be working tomorrow. 

* ****Roadmap****

  : Generate 6-week roadmaps based on the 3-month roadmaps given to you by the head of product.
* ****Own KPIs:****

  Drive feature adoption, deepen engagement, and improve retention and expansion for your portfolio of screens, with clear targets and regular reporting on how your work moves those numbers.
* ****Test hypotheses and run experiments:****

  Turn insights into clear hypotheses about activation, adoption or retention; design and run small, measurable experiments (A/B tests, copy/layout changes, onboarding tweaks), analyze the impact, and either iterate, scale, or kill ideas based on the data.
* ****Product Discovery****

  : Watch sales calls, use Mixpanel, Hotjar, talk with customer success and do competitive analysis to generate new feature ideas.
* ****Elicit requirements****

  : Establish communication with existing customers, build rapport with their users and elicit requirements for both new and existing features.
* ****Wireframe and User flows****

  : Use Miro to generate user flows for your new features, along with capturing how users use existing tools to solve their problems.
* ****Suggest new features and success KPIs****

  : Propose new features using data-driven arguments for them, and present it to the Head of Product.
  
  

****👓 Who you are****

* You have 3-5 years of experience in a B2B product management role with direct ownership of growth metrics such as activation, retention, feature adoption, not just delivery dates.
* Proven track record of running growth experiments (A/B tests, multivariate tests, or iterative launches), and using the results to iterate or kill ideas.
* You know when to say no. Protect the team from low-value work and scope creep
* You are able to work with senior Engineers presenting trade-offs e.g scope vs speed of delivering a feature.
* You earn the engineer’s trust in the teams you have worked with.
* You know how to communicate the same thing to different stakeholders: Engineers, Design, Sales, other Product owners.
* You know how to use data to extract conclusions and hypothesis.
* Experience with Perplexity (or similar) where output has helped shape features/capability
* Degree in Computer Science or other STEM background.
  
  

💗We would love if you have 

* Previous VC-backed start-up experience
* Experience in working with Data Scientists
* You have learned a new technical domain and shipped features to prove it.
* Created wireframes and designs for your features.
* Experience with Cursor or no-code tools (like Lovable)
* Experience with Figma Make, Claude Design, Impeccable or similar
  
  

****🤝 Who you will work with****

* You will  report to the Head of Product.
* We are a product centric company so the Product is the connection of multiple functions. Disciplines you will work and communicate with include: Engineers, QA, Design, other Product owners, Marketing, Customer Success, Sales.
* We’re remote-first, but if you miss the smell of whiteboard markers, we’ve got an office for you (Cyprus).
  
  

🏄
****What if you’re a partial fit?****

We prioritise grit, positivity, and drive for growth, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match this job description.

****Bonus****

: Figure out which part of this job opening was written by an AI and mention it in the interview.

****🌌 Location****

Spain, Germany, Cyprus, Remote

****👨‍👩‍👧 We are****

* Hard working but not workaholic
* Explorers. Data is our compass and innovation our destination
* Independent thinkers. We are not afraid of looking where no one else is
* Team players. We believe the whole is bigger than the sum of its parts
* We have strong opinions, weakly held
* Continuously evolving the way we do things. Even our #donut dates
  
  

Nodes & Links is an equal opportunity employer: we value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.

****🌴 Benefits****

Besides a competitive salary, we are also proud to support you with:

* A team of Noders who are second to none. Yep — the team is that good 🚀
* Equity in Nodes & Links — we are all in this together ✊
* One of the best health insurances out there (international coverage) ⚕️
* Remote work budget, to build your perfect set up (€500 year 1 + €100 year 2) 🏠
* Personal development budget, to keep growing (€1,000 pa) 📔
* Enhanced pension/providence fund (CY) (6% company contribution) 📈
* Annual #workation trip, to work and have fun with your teammates. We've been to Budapest, Crete, Aegina (x2) 💃🏻
* Wedding/Civil Partnerships additional leave of 3 days on us ❤️

title: Product Intern (on-site)
description:
**Your role**
We're building the AI operating system for the energy transition, and we ship faster than almost anyone in our market. There's always more product to build than hands to build it, and that's where you come in. You'll join the product team from day one, helping take features from idea to launch and shaping a product that thousands of installers across Europe rely on. Start as an intern, prove yourself, and grow into a permanent, full-time Junior PM role.
  
  
You'll work directly alongside our Product Managers, engineering team and with our CPO and co-founder in a team of 15 across product, engineering and design.
  
  
**Your mission**

* Test and validate new features before they ship, catching issues early so we keep quality high while moving fast.
* Turn user problems, edge cases, and feedback into clear, well-scoped product tickets and specs.
* Work shoulder to shoulder with PMs and engineers to move features from idea to launch and keep the pipeline flowing.
* Dig into how installers actually use the product, and feed what you learn back into what we build next.
* Take small product areas end to end as you grow, from writing the spec to seeing it live.
* Pick up whatever moves the product forward, from release checks to competitor research to quick data pulls.

**Your path here**
This is an intern role built to become a permanent one. You start close to the product, learning it inside out, and as you prove yourself you take on more ownership and grow into a full-time Junior PM role running your own product area. We're hiring for the person who wants that path, not a short stint before the next thing.
  
  
**Your profile**
We care more about how you think and what you've built than where you've been. Here's what will set you up for success in this role:
  
  

* You're genuinely excited about building great software products, and you care about getting the details right.
* You've finished your studies (or finish within the next few weeks), can start full-time soon, and want to build a career here rather than fill a gap before a masters.
* You think like a product person: you look at a feature and see the user, the outcome, and what's still missing.
* You're smart, you learn fast, and you move on your own initiative. We're not expecting polished PM skills yet, we're betting on how quickly you'll build them.
* Based in Berlin and energized by being in the room. We're intentionally office-first: decisions get made in real time, prototypes get stress-tested over lunch, and the founding team is ten meters away. If that's how you thrive, you'll feel at home here.

**Nice to have (but not required):**

* A project, side product, or internship where you owned something end to end.
* German or another European language on top of fluent English.

**Don't meet every requirement?**
Apply anyway. We hire for potential and perspective. Credentials are a starting point, not a ceiling.
  
  
**How We Hire**
We keep things transparent and respect your time. Most go from first call to offer in under three weeks.
  
  

* Intro call (30 min): We want to understand what you're looking for, not just screen your CV.
* Hiring manager interview (30 min): We go deep on your experience, your thinking, and how you approach problems.
* Final interview (30 min): A deeper chat with one of our Product Managers, about how you approach problems and work with a team.
* Offer & signed contract.

Need any adjustments at any stage? Just let us know.
  
  
**Why us?**

* Competitive pay. Fair compensation for your time and contribution, benchmarked to the Berlin internship market.
* AI-first & unthrottled. Unlimited enterprise-grade AI, no caps, no approval process. Every role, every team. The grunt work disappears so you can focus on what actually requires human judgement.
* Real ownership on a real mission. From day one you're shaping decisions that impact thousands of installers. We're not just building software, we're powering the energy transition across Europe.
* Grow faster than anywhere else. You'll work directly alongside the founding team and world-class investors. If you're building toward your own venture one day, there's no better room to be in.

**Perks & Benefits**

* Latest Apple hardware in our Prenzlauer Berg office
* 25 days vacation, prorated for part-time
* Urban Sports Club (M) membership
* Deutschlandticket, covered
* Cloover Power Tariff: our own green power tariff, with the monthly base fee on us
* Free catered lunch every day in the office (via Bella&Bona)
* Free dinner every day in the office (via Wolt)
* Fully stocked kitchen with breakfast, snacks, and drinks
* Team events with €50 per person per month
* Company discounts via Corporate Benefits and FutureBens

**About Us**
At Cloover, we’re building the AI operating system for the energy transition: a platform that helps thousands of installation companies across Germany and Austria sell more, plan faster, and deliver better. We’ve secured $1.32B in total financing: $1.3B in committed debt financing and a $22M Series A. We are just getting started on our European expansion.
  
  
We’re a high-performance team that works with purpose. We own our work fully, debate ideas hard, commit together, and execute without hesitation. Seniority doesn’t win arguments here. The best idea does. Speed isn’t a deadline we hit, it’s how we’re wired.
  
  
And we’re AI-first by default. We’re not experimenting with AI. We’re built on it. Tech ships faster because AI prototypes before we build. Sales closes more because outreach is personalized at scale. Finance stress-tests in real time. People & Culture builds processes in a fraction of the time. Whatever your function, AI is how we punch above our weight, and it’s a skill you’ll develop here faster than almost anywhere else.
  
  
We believe the energy transition belongs to everyone, and so does our team. We’re international, driven, and deliberately inclusive. We hire for potential and perspective, and we welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.
  
  
**Sound like your kind of challenge? Apply below.**

title: GTM Engineer
description:
Checkpoint GTM builds the systems that help B2B companies sell: CRMs, data flows, outbound engines and the automations that connect them. As a GTM Engineer, you'll sit at the technical core of our delivery team and own the build side of client projects, from architecture to go-live.

This is an engineering role first. CRM and go-to-market are the domain, but the day-to-day is building: workflows, integrations, data pipelines and internal tools. We're a small team, so you'll also help shape how we work. If you see a better way to deliver, we want to hear it, test it and make it our standard.

What you'll do

* Support the delivery of all Checkpoint GTM services. Explore our service offerings
* Design and build GTM systems for clients across HubSpot, Salesforce and AI, including data models, workflows, integrations and reporting.
* Own the technical side of client projects end to end: scoping, solution design, build, testing and handover.
* Build outbound and enrichment systems in Clay, n8n, lemlist, Cargo and Instantly: lead generation, ICP mapping and personalised messaging at scale.
* Write SQL, Python or TypeScript and work with REST APIs when no-code tools hit their limits.
* Plan and run data migrations and integrations between systems without losing or breaking data.
* Document data architectures, process maps and integration specs so clients can run what we build.
* Turn repeat work into reusable templates, playbooks and internal tools.
* Try new tools and approaches, AI included where it helps, and share what works with the team.
* Work with senior consultants on client strategy and enablement, and mentor our working students.

What we're looking for

* **3+ years of experience in GTM engineering, RevOps, marketing or sales operations, or a similar technical role.**
* **Expert knowledge of HubSpot or Salesforce.** You have hands-on experience implementing at least one of them: objects, properties, workflows, reports and dashboards, user management and integrations.
* Solid technical skills: you're comfortable with SQL, at least one of Python or TypeScript, and REST APIs and webhooks.
* Hands-on experience with automation and outbound tools such as Clay, n8n, Make, Zapier, lemlist or Instantly.
* A structured way of turning business requirements into system logic.
* The ability to manage several client projects at once and deliver on time and on budget.
* Clear written and spoken English for client calls and documentation.
* Initiative: you don't wait to be told what to do next, and you speak up when you see a better way.

Nice to have

* Expertise in both HubSpot and Salesforce.
* HubSpot or Salesforce certifications.
* German language skills.
* Agency or consulting experience across several clients.
* Something you've built end to end on your own, like a side project, an integration or an internal tool.

Tools you'll work with

* **CRM:** HubSpot, Salesforce
* **Outbound and enrichment:** Clay, lemlist, Instantly, HeyReach, Cargo, Apollo
* **Automation:** n8n, Make, Zapier
* **Data and code:** SQL, Python, TypeScript, REST APIs
* **Sales tools:** Aircall, Gong
* **AI:** Claude, Codex, ChatGPT

Why join

* Ownership of the technical side of client projects, with direct impact on client results.
* A say in how a small, growing team works: your ideas get heard, tested and shipped.
* Work with senior RevOps and GTM engineers with 80+ implementations behind them.
* Exposure across the full modern GTM stack for many companies, not just one.
* Full access to the tools we use in client work, including Claude and Codex.
* Regular team meetups for strategy sessions and time together.
* Everyone at Checkpoint has the option of a 4-day work week for 5-day pay. We value work-life balance and the promotion of your creative endeavours outside the office.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: 50.000,00€ - 90.000,00€ per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Berlin (Berlin)

* Screening call with our Lead Venture Development

* Final on-site interview with our COO Thies and the team

Heating our buildings causes around 25% of Europe's CO₂ emissions. Decarbonizing it depends on installers – and there are far too few of them to keep up with the growing demand for heat pumps.
  
  
autarc is building the operating system for energy installers across Europe: software that makes planning, designing and installing heat pumps faster and more digital. Our goal is to help plan and design 1 million heat pumps by 2030.
  
  
Founded in Berlin and backed by Y Combinator (S24), we're a team of 60+ people across Sales, Tech and Operations, already serving more than 2,000 customers.

title: Werkstudent:in AI & Automation - Energy (m/w/d)
description:

Bei
**1KOMMA5°**
bauen wir Europas führende Energie-Software-Plattform
**“Heartbeat”**
und schaffen so ein
**virtuelles Kraftwerk**
, das Photovoltaik, Stromspeicher, Wärmepumpen und Ladesäulen der Kunden verknüpft und so die Rentabilität vernetzter Kundenanlagen deutlich erhöht. Wir bieten Kunden zudem einen "
**One-Stop-Shop"**
für den Kauf und die Installation individueller und intelligenter Energie-Systemlösungen, damit jeder Haushalt schnell und professionell klimaneutral wohnen, heizen und mobil sein kann. Gleichzeitig arbeiten wir in unserer Technologie-Sparte an der Weiterentwicklung und dem Ausbau der Heartbeat-Software, um Kunden
**weltweit**
mit dem Strommarkt zu vernetzen und so immer den
**günstigsten und saubersten Stromtarif**
anbieten zu können.
  
  
Erfahre mehr über unser Product & Tech Team!
  
  
**Deine Position**
Als
**Team Energy**
sind wir Teil des Product und Tech Teams von 1KOMMA5°. Wir arbeiten täglich daran, dass unsere digitalen Produkte tausenden Kund:innen weltweit zur Verfügung stehen. Wir wachsen stark und suchen deshalb weitere Verstärkung! Was zählt ist, dass du motiviert bist, die untenstehende Aufgaben anzugehen, Gas (bzw. Strom) zu geben und eine steile Lernkurve suchst.
  
  

* Du übernimmst eigenständig KI- und Automatisierungsprojekte – von der RAG-gestützten Datenverarbeitung bis hin zu automatisierter Kundenkommunikation
* Du nutzt Automatisierungsplattformen für schnelles Prototyping von KI-Anwendungen
* Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Process- und Operations-Team zusammen, um die Herausforderungen im Tagesgeschäft zu verstehen
* Darauf aufbauend entwickelst du passende Lösungen und bewertest deren Impact anhand klar messbarer KPIs
* Du dokumentierst deine Workflows in unserer Wissensdatenbank und unterstützt dabei, unseren Teamkontext für AI-Agenten nutzbar zu machen
* Du evaluierst eigenständig neue AI-Tools und Automatisierungsplattformen und bringst Vorschläge ein, wie wir Prozesse weiter verbessern und automatisieren können

**Dein Profil**

* Du studierst Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Data Science oder ein vergleichbares Fach – oder bist tech-affin mit nachweisbarer Erfahrung
* Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit Automatisierungsplattformen (z.B. n8n, Make, Zapier)
* Du besitzt eine ausgeprägte hands-on Mentalität und bringst proaktiv Initiativen voran
* Du bist noch mindestens zwei Semester an einer deutschen Hochschule immatrikuliert und kannst uns 15-20 Stunden pro Woche und in den Semesterferien bis zu 40 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen
* Für diese Stelle ist es unerlässlich, dass du dich wohl damit fühlst fließend auf Deutsch zu kommunizieren (mind. C1 Niveau)
* Du suchst eine steile Lernkurve und bist offen für Feedback - jeder Mensch kann dazulernen, genau dafür wollen wir Raum geben
* Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft? Super! Du bist noch Rookie in der Branche? Kein Problem – für uns zählt Motivation und Lernwille!

**Benefits**

* Du hast die Möglichkeit in unseren brandneuen Büros in der Hamburger Innenstadt, Berlin & München zu arbeiten und/oder remote
* Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich gut mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen
* Nutze dein technisches Equipment auch abseits der Arbeit in deiner Freizeit
* Viel Eigenverantwortung und die Möglichkeit eigene Themen zu übernehmen
* Du bewegst dich in flachen Hierarchien mit viel Entwicklungspotenzial
* Mit deiner Arbeit unterstützt du den Megatrend “Energie- und Mobilitätswende” und leistest einen konkreten Beitrag zum nachhaltigen Umbau unserer Energie-Infrastruktur
* Sei aktiv und nutze das Angebot von über 7.600 Sportpartnern mit dem EGYM-Wellpass
* Profitiere von Benefits & Rabatten durch Futurebens

Die 1KOMMA5° Gruppe ist ein CleanTech Unicorn mit der Mission alles zu elektrifizieren und über unsere KI-basierte Software Plattform Heartbeat AI jeden an den Strommarkt der Zukunft anzuschließen. Wir sind das marktführende Unternehmen für die Installation von CO2-neutralen Energiesystemen, insbesondere bei Photovoltaik, Energiespeicher, Wallbox, Wärmepumpe und Energiemanagement. 1KOMMA5° vereint die besten Unternehmen Deutschlands, Europas und darüber hinaus – wir wachsen weiter und das weltweit.

title: Product Owner (all genders)
description:
**Product Owner (all genders)**

Festanstellung, Vollzeit | Augsburg, Krumbach, Berlin, Ingolstadt, Erlangen, Leipzig, Münster, München, Karlsruhe

XITASO ist ein gefragter Partner für anspruchsvolle
**Software- und Digitalisierungsprojekte**
in Branchen wie
**Anlagen- und Maschinenbau, Robotik, Medizintechnik**
sowie dem
**öffentlichen Sektor**
.

Als Product Owner (all genders) gestaltest du digitale Lösungen von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden und interdisziplinären Teams aus Software Engineers, UI/UX-Expert\*innen und Agile Coaches entwickelst du innovative Lösungen für komplexe Herausforderungen.

**Was uns dabei besonders macht:**
Wir arbeiten in
**selbstorganisierten Teams**
,
**übernehmen Verantwortung**
und
**gestalten**
sowohl unsere Zusammenarbeit als auch die Zukunft von XITASO aktiv mit. Bei uns hast du den Freiraum, deine Ideen einzubringen und dich persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.

**Diese Aufgaben interessieren Dich:**

* Du
  **entwickelst**
  gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden in einem interdisziplinären Team die
  **Produktvision**
  und
  **Konzepte für individuelle Softwarelösungen**
  und führst diese erfolgreich von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung.
* Du
  **verantwortest**
  das
  **Anforderungsmanagement**
  – von der Planung und Durchführung von
  **Workshops**
  über die Erstellung und Priorisierung von
  **User Stories**
  bis hin zur Pflege des
  **Product Backlogs**
  .
* Du
  **übernimmst die Projektverantwortung**
  und behältst Projektfortschritt, Ziele, Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und Teamauslastung im Blick.
* Du
  **steuerst**
  und
  **begleitest**
  das
  **Team**
  durch den agilen Entwicklungsprozess und gestaltest gemeinsam mit ihm Dailys, Reviews und Retrospektiven. Dabei werdet ihr von unseren Agile Coaches unterstützt.
* Du
  **gestaltest XITASO aktiv**
  mit und bringst Deine Erfahrungen, Ideen und Impulse auch über Dein Projekt hinaus in unsere Communities und die Weiterentwicklung des Unternehmens ein.

**Das zeichnet Dich aus:**

* Du verfügst über ein
  **abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Mathematik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Naturwissenschaften, Technik**
  oder bringst durch deine bisherige Berufserfahrung nachweislich ein sehr gutes
  **Verständnis für technische Zusammenhänge**
  mit.
* Idealerweise hast du bereits
  **Erfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer**
  oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle und kennst die Zusammenarbeit in agilen Softwareteams.
* Du kannst dich
  **schnell in neue Themen einarbeiten**
  und findest dich in sehr
  **unterschiedlichen Kundendomänen**
  zügig zurecht.
* Es fällt dir leicht,
  **komplexe Zusammenhänge**
  für die Zielgruppe passend
  **darzustellen**
  – verbal, schriftlich und visuell.
* Du bist
  **neugierig auf neue Technologien**
  und offen dafür,
  **KI-gestützte Werkzeuge**
  sinnvoll in deinen Arbeitsalltag zu integrieren.
* Du bringst dein
  **ausgeprägtes Organisationstalent**
  gerne in Projekte ein.
* Du hast
  **Freude an der Zusammenarbeit und Kommunikation mit Kunden**
  und vertrittst klare Empfehlungen auch dann überzeugend, wenn unterschiedliche Interessen aufeinandertreffen. Dabei gelingt es Dir, verschiedene Perspektiven zusammenzubringen und alle Beteiligten auf dem gemeinsamen Weg mitzunehmen.
* Du
  **schätzt**
  die
  **agile Arbeitsweise,**
  bringst ein
  **offenes Mindset**
  mit und hast Freude daran,
  **Verantwortung in einem selbstorganisierten Team**
  zu übernehmen.
* Du besitzt
  **sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1-Level)**
  für eine klare und sichere Kommunikation im Team und mit unseren Partnern.

**Das bieten wir Dir:**

🌱
**New Work & Kultur**

* Selbstorganisierte Teams mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum
* Verantwortung und Mitgestaltung
* Offene Fehler- und Feedbackkultur

🤝
**Mentoring & persönliche Entwicklung**

* Individuelles Mentoring ab dem ersten Tag
* Regelmäßige Entwicklungsgespräche („Catch-ups“)
* Führung auf Augenhöhe, basierend auf Vertrauen und Respekt

📚
**Lebenslanges Lernen**

* Fachliche und überfachliche Trainings
* Interne TechTalks, externe Fortbildungen und Konferenzen

💻
**High-End Software Engineering**

* Anspruchsvolle, innovative und vielseitige Projekte
* Cross-funktionale Teams mit modernen Technologien
* Gelebte Expertenkultur und teamübergreifender Wissensaustausch

👨 👩 👧
**Familienfreundlichkeit**

* Zuschuss zu Betreuungskosten bis zu 250 €/Kind
* Lohnfortzahlung für Kinderkrankentage

💬
**Gemeinschaft & Events**

* Regelmäßige Events (z. B. Retreats, Sommerfeste)
* Persönliche Begegnungen & Teamzusammenhalt
* Ab Tag 1 Teil der vielfältig vernetzten Community

🕓
**Arbeitszeit & Flexibilität**

* Freie Wahl von Arbeitszeit und -ort
* Flexible Arbeitszeitkonten, 30 Tage Urlaub, Teilzeitoption, Sabbatical & Workation

💚
**Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden**

* Mental Health Taskforce
* JobRad & weitere Angebote

🌍
**Vielfalt & Inklusion**

* Diversity Taskforce für Perspektivenvielfalt
* Kultur der Zugehörigkeit: Jede\*r soll sich angenommen fühlen

**Gehaltsinformationen:**

Innerhalb unseres einheitlichen und transparenten Gehaltsframeworks ordnet sich das Bruttojahresgehalt der Position bei einer Spanne von 64.000 – 86.000 EUR ein und orientiert sich an verschiedenen Faktoren, wie Qualifikation und Erfahrung.

**Lerne uns und unsere Arbeitsweise besser kennen:**

description:
P-1453
  
  
At Databricks, we are passionate about helping data teams solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.
  
  
As an Associate Product Manager, you will join a team that works diligently to understand and solve our customers’ most challenging problems. We're hiring across all of our teams, including Machine Learning, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, ETL, Streaming, EDA, and Content Organization. You will have a dedicated mentor and will join our 2027 APM cohortwhere you'll connect with product managers, engineers, designers, account teams, other interns, and leaders from across the company.
  
  
We are hiring for Amsterdam, Berlin and Belgrade
  
  
**The Impact You Will Have**

* Work with a team to build features for the Databricks platform
* Manage your project end-to-end, including design, code, and feedback
* Learn about building a platform that scales quickly while maintaining quality and security

**What We Look For**

* You will graduate between Fall 2026 and Summer 2027 with a bachelors or masters degree in computer science or related engineering practice
* You have some experience with SQL and/or Python
* You can leverage analytical skills to make data-driven decisions (e.g. analyze product usage)
* You are able to make complex topics simple and clearly communicate nuance to stakeholders (engineers, customers, field, etc.) in both written and verbal form
* You are excited to solve ambiguous problems with a collaborative team

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
  
  
**Compliance**
**If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.**

title: Product Manager (m/f/d)
description:
**Verstehe, wie Menschen arbeiten. Bau die Software, die ihre Arbeit besser macht.**
Bei Buena kaufen wir Hausverwaltungen und entwickeln die Software, mit der sie täglich arbeiten. Wir können direkt beobachten, wo Prozesse haken, welche Informationen fehlen und was Menschen unnötig Zeit kostet.
  
  
Wir suchen einen Product Manager, der diese Probleme verstehen und lösen will. Du gehst zu den Nutzern, erkennst gemeinsame Bedürfnisse über mehrere Verwaltungen hinweg und übersetzt deine Erkenntnisse in klare Prioritäten und konkrete Produktverbesserungen.
  
  
Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering und Design zusammen. Du gestaltest die Richtung und kümmerst dich um die Details, die aus einer guten Idee ein funktionierendes Produkt machen.
  
  
Was du bei uns machst
  
  

* Nutzer und Arbeitsabläufe verstehen: Du beobachtest die Arbeit in unseren Hausverwaltungen und findest auch Probleme, die uns über Supportanfragen oder Online-Feedback bisher nicht erreichen.
* Gemeinsame Bedürfnisse erkennen: Du vergleichst Abläufe zwischen Verwaltungen und identifizierst Verbesserungen mit dem größten Nutzen.
* Die Roadmap gestalten: Du verbindest einzelne Projekte mit einer klaren Produktrichtung, begründest Prioritäten und machst sie für das Team verständlich.
* Lösungen entwickeln: Du recherchierst Alternativen, erarbeitest Vorschläge und durchdenkst Nutzerabläufe gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design.
* Zusammenhänge durchdringen: Du verstehst, wie Immobilien, Einheiten, Eigentümer, Dokumente und weitere Daten miteinander verbunden sind – und welche Folgen Änderungen an einer Stelle haben.
* Von der Idee bis zur Nutzung begleiten: Du lieferst die passende Detailtiefe für ein Projekt, klärst offene Fragen während der Entwicklung und überprüfst nach dem Release, ob die Verbesserung ankommt.
* KI praktisch einsetzen: Du nutzt Tools, um Produktverhalten zu untersuchen, Ideen auszuprobieren, Prototypen zu bauen und Tests zu unterstützen.

Was du mitbringst
  
  

* Erfahrung mit Software für reale Arbeitsabläufe: Beispielsweise aus ERP, Supply Chain, HR, CRM oder anderen komplexen Geschäftsprozessen. Du verstehst, dass Software bestehende Abläufe und Rahmenbedingungen berücksichtigen muss.
* Starke Discovery-Fähigkeiten: Du fragst präzise nach, gehst über den ersten Wunsch hinaus und findest heraus, welches Problem tatsächlich gelöst werden muss.
* Gutes Produkturteil: Du machst aus einer unübersichtlichen Ausgangslage eine klare Richtung, sinnvolle Prioritäten und verständliche Nutzerabläufe.
* Verständnis für verknüpfte Systeme: Du kannst Beziehungen zwischen Daten und die Auswirkungen von Veränderungen nachvollziehen.
* Praktische technische und KI-Kompetenz: Du kannst mit Tools ein System untersuchen und einen Prototypen bauen. Eigenständig produktionsreifen Code zu liefern, setzen wir nicht voraus.
* Eigenverantwortung und Teamfähigkeit: Du bringst klare Vorschläge ein, lässt sie hinterfragen und entwickelst mit anderen eine bessere Lösung.
* Eine pragmatische Arbeitsweise: Du kommst mit Unsicherheit zurecht, arbeitest dich in Details ein und bringst Dinge in einem kleinen Team voran.

Du musst noch kein Experte für Hausverwaltung sein. Du brauchst die Neugier und Fähigkeit, dich in diese Welt einzuarbeiten. Erfahrung in einem frühen Startup kann dafür ein guter Beleg sein – wir sind aber offen für unterschiedliche Hintergründe.
  
  
Warum du bei Buena einsteigen solltest
  
  

* Du bist nah am Problem: Du hast direkten Zugang zu unseren Nutzern und kannst überprüfen, ob deine Arbeit ihren Alltag verbessert.
* Du gestaltest das Produkt mit: In unserem kleinen Team haben deine Erkenntnisse und Entscheidungen direkten Einfluss darauf, was wir als Nächstes bauen.
* Du wächst mit deinem Beitrag: Gute Ergebnisse führen bei uns schnell zu mehr Verantwortung.
* Du arbeitest eng mit dem Team: Persönlicher Austausch und kurze Wege sind uns wichtig. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam aus unserem Büro in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg.

Deine Benefits
  
  

* Büronähe wird belohnt: Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus bei einem Wohnort mit 10–20 Minuten Fußweg zum Büro.
* Verpflegung: 110 € monatliches Lunch-Budget.
* Sport: 50 € Fitnesszuschuss.
* Weiterentwicklung: 1.200 € Bildungsbudget pro Jahr.
* Lesestoff: Bücher, die du lesen möchtest, übernehmen wir.

**Du willst komplexe Abläufe verstehen und daraus ein Produkt machen, das Menschen gerne nutzen? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.**

title: Volunteer - Remote or Hybrit Berlin - Entrepreneurship and Virtual Events - Women Empowerment
description:
**Join Our Global Mission to Empower Women Entrepreneurs**

Are you passionate about women's empowerment, entrepreneurship, and creating meaningful impact? Would you like to gain hands-on experience working with an international community of female founders, entrepreneurs, innovators, and changemakers?

**Female Founder Space** is looking for motivated volunteers to support our growing global community and help organize the **Global Female Entrepreneurs Summit 2026**.

Whether your interests are in virtual events, social media, content creation, marketing, communications, or community engagement, this is an opportunity to build valuable professional skills while contributing to a meaningful mission.

**Position:** Volunteer

**Location:** Remote (Worldwide) or Hybrid in Berlin, Germany

**Commitment:** Flexible schedule (approximately **10–20 hours per week**)

**Why Volunteer With Us?**

Become part of a global movement dedicated to supporting women entrepreneurs and creating opportunities for women in business worldwide.

**As a volunteer, you will:**

* Make a real social impact by helping empower women through education, networking, and entrepreneurship.
* Gain practical experience in international events, digital marketing, communications, and community building.
* Work alongside an inspiring team of passionate professionals and volunteers from around the world.
* Build your professional portfolio with meaningful projects and real responsibilities.
* Expand your international network by connecting with entrepreneurs, founders, speakers, mentors, and industry experts.
* Receive exclusive access to summit sessions, workshops, networking events, and educational resources.

**Tasks**
---------

**Volunteer Opportunities**

Depending on your interests and skills, you may support one or more of the following areas:

**Virtual Event Support**

* Assist with planning and coordinating online events and webinars.
* Support speakers before and during live sessions.
* Moderate sessions and manage audience engagement.
* Help facilitate networking sessions, breakout rooms, and virtual community activities.
* Provide technical assistance to attendees when needed.

**Social Media & Community Engagement**

* Create and schedule engaging social media content.
* Share event updates and promotional campaigns.
* Interact with our online community across social platforms.
* Help grow awareness of our programs and initiatives.
* Support community engagement before, during, and after events.

**Content Writing & Communications**

* Write blog articles about entrepreneurship, startups, innovation, and women's leadership.
* Help prepare newsletters and email campaigns.
* Assist with website content updates.
* Create speaker spotlights, success stories, interviews, and event recaps.
* Support marketing and communication materials.

**Marketing & Operations**

* Help organize digital resources and event materials.
* Assist with volunteer coordination and project management.
* Support research, outreach, and partnership initiatives.
* Contribute ideas to improve community engagement and member experience.

**Requirements**
----------------

**Who We're Looking For**

We're looking for enthusiastic people who enjoy learning, taking initiative, and making a positive impact.

You are someone who:

* Is passionate about women's empowerment and entrepreneurship.
* Has a positive attitude and an open-minded mindset.
* Is reliable, organized, and proactive.
* Can work independently in a remote environment.
* Has good written and spoken English (our working language).
* Communicates clearly and enjoys working with an international team.
* Is interested in digital marketing, communications, events, startups, education, or nonprofit work.
* Is familiar with tools such as Zoom, Canva, Google Workspace, or social media platforms (a plus, but not required).

Students, recent graduates, career changers, and professionals are all welcome to apply.

**Benefits**
------------

**What You'll Gain**

* Flexible working hours that fit around your studies or work.
* Fully remote volunteering with optional hybrid collaboration in Berlin.
* A supportive, international, and friendly team.
* Hands-on experience in digital marketing, communications, event management, and community building.
* Opportunities to develop highly valuable professional skills.
* Practical knowledge about entrepreneurship, startups, business, innovation, and nonprofit organizations.
* The opportunity to contribute to projects that positively impact women worldwide.
* A professional recommendation/reference upon successful completion.
* Free lifetime access to the Female Founder Space global community.
* Free access to our online courses, workshops, and educational resources.
* Exclusive access to the Global Female Entrepreneurs Summit 2026.

**Start Date:** September, 2026 (flexible onboarding)

**Volunteer Period:** September – December 2026

**Application Deadline:** **Tuesday, September 15, 2026.**

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible.

***Please note:*** *This is an* ***unpaid volunteer position\*****. While financial compensation is not provided, volunteers receive valuable hands-on experience, mentorship, networking opportunities, a professional reference upon successful completion, lifetime access to our global community and online courses, and the opportunity to contribute to a meaningful mission that empowers women entrepreneurs worldwide.*

**How to Apply**

If you'd like to become part of our international team, we'd love to hear from you.

Please send us:

* Your CV or résumé
* A short motivation (5–7 sentences) explaining:
* **Why** you would like to volunteer with Female Founder Space
* **How** you believe you can contribute to our mission
* Which areas interest you most (events, social media, content writing, newsletters, marketing, communications, community management, etc.)

Join us in empowering women entrepreneurs around the world and help create an unforgettable Global Female Entrepreneurs Summit 2026. Together, we can build a more inclusive and connected entrepreneurial future.

description:
**Gemeinsam machen wir den Unterschied**
**Siemens Mobility**
ist ein eigenständig geführtes Unternehmen der Siemens AG und seit über 160 Jahren ein führender Anbieter im Bereich Mobilität. Zu unserem Kerngeschäft gehören Schienenfahrzeuge, Bahnautomatisierungs- und Elektrifizierungslösungen, schlüsselfertige Systeme sowie die dazugehörigen Serviceleistungen. Wir waren schon immer sehr innovativ, um Reisen schneller, sicherer und komfortabler zu machen. Heute brauchen wir neue Lösungen für neue Herausforderungen wie den Klimawandel und weltweit steigende Bevölkerungszahlen. Das ist es, was uns antreibt. Deshalb gestalten wir Mobilität mit Leidenschaft und sind immer einen Schritt voraus. Durch Digitalisierung machen wir Infrastrukturen intelligent und schaffen Möglichkeiten, die uns nachhaltig und nahtlos von A nach B bringen. title: PhD position (m/f/d)
description:
The Fritz Haber Institute of the Max Planck Society for the Advancement of Science () is one of the most internationally renowned research institutes. More than 400 employees in 5 scientific departments conduct and facilitate top-level research on historic grounds in Berlin-Dahlem, which is unique worldwide.

**PhD position (m/f/d)**
========================

The Department of Interface Science () headed by Prof. Beatriz Roldan Cuenya at the Fritz-Haber-Institute carries out cutting-edge research on advanced functional materials with applications in heterogeneous catalysis, energy conversion and electrochemistry. By combining unique synthesis methods, state-of-the art tools for experimental characterization and advanced approaches to data analysis, atomistic details of thermal catalysis and electrochemical reactions at gas/solid and liquid/solid interfaces are revealed. In particular, structure-reactivity correlations on nanostructured materials can be established, paving the way for the rational design of novel catalytic materials.

**Project**

**Operando characterization of electrochemical carbon capture processes**

We have an immediate opening for a PhD student position in “Carbon capture group” (), led by Dr. Valentin Briega Martos. Carbon capture technologies are a key component of CO**₂** management, with the most common examples using absorbent solutions with capture agents to bind the CO**₂** and release in a subsequent step in a purified stream. However, these methods are limited by the temperature swings needed for adsorption and desorption, rendering to low efficiencies. One alternative is to directly reduce the CO**₂** in the capture liquids to high value chemicals by using electricity coming from renewable energies such as wind and solar energies. In order to optimize these technologies, the mechanisms of the reduction of the adducts between CO**₂** and the capture molecule need to be understood, as well as the dynamic reconstruction processes of the used electrocatalysts under reaction conditions. We will employ in-situ and operando characterization methods coupled to benchtop electrochemical cells and electrolyzers, like for example spectroscopy and mass spectrometry techniques, to identify and quantify the reaction intermediates and products from the reduction of capture liquids. Surface characterization and on-line dissolution techniques will be used to track the dynamic changes of the surface and the morphologies of the catalysts while the reaction is taking place. The obtained results will improve our understanding of the electrochemical carbon capture processes that will help designing new electrocatalysts and electrochemical processes to advance this technology.

The PhD position is typically for three years.

Requirements

* Experience with electrocatalytic experiments and ability to independently carry out electrochemical investigations is mandatory.
* Good language and communication skills in English are needed.
* Basic programming skills and experience and interest in data analysis, data science, machine learning and process automation would be an advantage.
* Previous experience with characterization techniques such as infrared and/or Raman spectroscopy, mass spectrometry or X-ray synchrotron-based techniques would be beneficial but is not mandatory.
* Master degree in physics, chemistry, materials science or related field is necessary.

We offer

* Possibility to make an important contribution to international research, and work both on our fundamental understanding of catalysis mechanisms, as well as on practically and industrially relevant research problems
* Extensive training and possibility to learn the cutting-edge experimental and data analysis methods.
* Access to world-class international large scale facilities in Germany and Europe, and unique laboratory-based infrastructure.
* An attractive, friendly, diverse and respectful work environment
* Attractive and individualized training opportunities, e.g., through the Planck Academy.
* Subsidy for the job ticket, very good connections to public transport, bicycle parking, charging stations for e-cars, good parking facilities.
* A friendly and respectful international working environment.

Your application

Please submit your application via our online application portal as soon as possible but not later than **November 22, 2026** including the following documents:

* Cover letter
* Curriculum vitae
* List of publications
* Names and email addresses of three references.

Applications will be accepted from immediately until the position is filled. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those individuals selected for an interview will be contacted.

**For more information, please contact**:

Dr. Valentin Briega Martos ()

Fritz-Haber-Institut der Max-Planck-Gesellschaft, Faradayweg 4-6, 14195 Berlin

Max PlanckSociety

The Max Planck Society endeavors to achieve gender equality and diversity. Furthermore, the Max Planck Society aims to increase the participation of women in research. Therefore, applications by women are particularly welcome. The Max Planck Society is also committed to increasing the number of individuals with disabilities in its workforce and therefore encourages applications from such qualified individuals.

title: Werkstudent Wirtschaftswissenschaften / BWL (m/w/d) - KI & Digitalisierung
description:
Du bringst gerne Struktur in komplexe Abläufe, analysierst Kennzahlen mit scharfem Blick und probierst neue KI-Möglichkeiten aus – verlierst dabei aber nie die nötigen Details für Prozesse aus den Augen und zeigst Eigeninitiative? Als Teil unseres Teams Einkauf und Beschaffung versorgst du das Unternehmen mit allen notwendigen indirekten Gütern und Dienstleistungen – in der richtigen Qualität, zur richtigen Zeit und zum besten Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis. Deine Formel für den Erfolg: 60% operatives Business & Administration + 40% KI, Data Analytics & Reporting.

Wir suchen langfristige Unterstützung für ca. 2 Jahre (20 Std. pro Woche) und bieten dir eine attraktive Vergütung zwischen 16,00 € und 22,00 € pro Stunde (je nach Vorerfahrung) bei flexibler Arbeitszeitgestaltung passend zu deinem Studium.
